programme.desc: Valeria le propone a Franco vivir juntos, pero él se niega porque Mía es su prioridad y debe estar libre para ella. El padre de Karen le prohíbe a Nico que vaya al café y que se olvide de la banda por terminar la relación con Karen.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 150
programme.desc: La banda se entera que Gastón estuvo en el café y los vio tocar. Galia habla con Pilar y le dice que cada una deberá enfrentar sus errores. Mía pelea con Miguel por culpa de Luz Viviana, ella amenaza con contarle a su papá que está en la banda.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 151
programme.desc: Giovanni logra escapar de La Logia, Miguel y los demás chicos informan al director que Giovanni y Teo no están en el colegio. Tomás y Lupita están discutiendo y escuchan un golpe, es Giovanni quien cae de la azotea.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 152
programme.desc: Afortunadamente Teo no está muerto, Enrique y los chicos lo reaniman mientras esperan a los paramédicos. Carlo le dice a Alma que alguien debe poner a Roberta en su lugar. El director Pascual no cree en la existencia de La Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 153
programme.desc: José visita a Teo en el hospital y le dice que lo ama. Alma toma la decisión de irse debido al comportamiento de Roberta. Giovanni confiesa que sabe dónde están los archivos de La Logia y los nombres de los integrantes.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 154
programme.desc: La habitación de la azotea arde en llamas, Pascual y Galia corren para controlar el fuego. El director Pascual y el Lic. Mendiola no saben qué hacer con los alumnos que forman La Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 155
programme.desc: Pascual y el Lic. Mendiola llegan a un acuerdo para que nadie se entere sobre La Logia. Roberta trata de hablar con su madre, pero Alma sigue muy dolida. Giovanni es expulsado del colegio. Pilar le confiesa a Pascual que es parte de La Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 156
programme.desc: Enrique le hace saber a todo el colegio, que la escuela opera bajo una Logia y León sugiere clausurar el colegio. Carlo le propone una nueva oportunidad de trabajo en Estados Unidos a Alma. Giovanni discute con su papá por haberse unido a la Logia.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 157
programme.desc: Miguel ya no quiere trabajar para Franco, pero él le pide que vaya con Mía a un viaje. Mía le pide a Alma que hable con su papá para que la deje cantar en el grupo. Alma le confiesa a Franco que las niñas falsificaron las firmas en el contrato del grupo.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 158
programme.desc: Ante el problema de la gaceta, Miguel defiende a Mía y les dice que él es su novio. Roberta le cuenta a Luján que Teo está enamorado de ella, pero Luján no le cree. Gastón agradece a Miguel por haber dicho que él es el novio de Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 159
programme.desc: El director del colegio le informa a Enrique que está despedido, pero él no acepta. Durante la cena, Mía pierde el control y al destapar la champaña, moja a todos. Luz intenta seducir a Miguel en el baño de hombres, pero Mía entra y la golpea.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 160
programme.desc: Todos los alumnos se encuentran en Canadá a pesar de ir separados. Valeria quiere vivir con Franco, pero él no está de acuerdo. Alma le comenta a Pepa que le hace daño a su hija Roberta. Carlo le dice a Franco que se irá a Nueva York con Alma.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 161
programme.desc: Franco se encuentra a Alma en un restaurante, pero se entera su novia y se molesta. Lupita le cuenta a Pilar que Tomás la besó. Mía le propone a Diego tener un romance en Canadá, al igual que Miguel a Roberta. Enrique tiene una discusión con Renata.

programme.title: El día de las madres

programme.title: Adiós Lagunilla, adiós

They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: Gamer
programme.desc: Each week Kable, a death-row inmate, battles his fellow prisoners in a violent online game called "Slayers," his every move controlled by a young gamer's remote device. To the players, Kable and the other inmates are just simulated characters. But, to a resistance group that opposes the game's inventor, Kable is a critical component of their plan to end the inventor's form of high-tech slavery.

programme.title: Kin
programme.desc: While scavenging for copper wire, Detroit teenager Eli Solinski stumbles upon a high-tech gun that holds special powers. When his brother, Jimmy, lands in trouble with a local crime boss, the two siblings take the mysterious weapon and go on the run. Eli and Jimmy now find themselves in a life-and-death battle against an army of thugs and two heavily armored, futuristic soldiers who want their gun back.

programme.title: Latency
programme.desc: An agoraphobic gamer agrees to test new equipment that uses AI to interpret the electrical activity of her brain. Soon, the line between reality and her subconscious starts to blur as she wonders if the device is serving a sinister force.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward a collision course with Earth. With only weeks before impact, NASA executive Jacinda "Jo" Fowler teams up with a man from her past and a conspiracy theorist for an impossible mission into space to save humanity.

programme.title: Source Code
programme.desc: Helicopter pilot Colter Stevens (Jake Gyllenhaal) is part of a top-secret military operation that enables him to experience the last few minutes in the life of Sean Fentress, a man who died in a commuter-train explosion. The purpose of Colter's mission is to learn the identity of the bomber and prevent a similar catastrophe. As Colter lives Sean's final moments, he becomes more certain that he can prevent the first tragedy from occurring -- as long as he doesn't run out of time.

programme.title: Ender's Game
programme.desc: When hostile aliens called the Formics attack Earth, only the legendary heroics of Mazer Rackham (Ben Kingsley) manage to attain a victory. To prepare for the next attack, Col. Hyrum Graff (Harrison Ford) and his cohorts initiate a military program to find the next Mazer. Recruit Ender Wiggin (Asa Butterfield) exhibits an unusual gift for the training, easily mastering all the challenges thrown at him. Mazer Rackham, himself, takes Ender as a protégé to prepare him for the oncoming war.

programme.title: Escape Room

programme.title: The Mist
programme.desc: After a powerful storm damages their Maine home, David Drayton (Thomas Jane) and his young son head into town to gather food and supplies. Soon afterward, a thick fog rolls in and engulfs the town, trapping the Draytons and others in the grocery store. Terror mounts as deadly creatures reveal themselves outside, but that may be nothing compared to the threat within, where a zealot (Marcia Gay Harden) calls for a sacrifice.

programme.title: The Crazies
programme.desc: Anarchy reigns when an unknown toxin turns the peaceful citizens of Ogden Marsh into bloodthirsty lunatics. In an effort to contain the spread of the infection, authorities blockade the town and use deadly force to keep anyone from getting in or out. Now trapped among killers, Sheriff Dutton and his wife and two companions must band together to find a way out before madness and death overtake them.

programme.title: Cabin Fever
programme.desc: Bert (James DeBello), a college student vacationing with friends in the mountains, mistakenly shoots a local man (Arie Verveen) with a skin infection while hunting in the woods. Panicking, he abandons the scene and leaves the man for dead. When the man stumbles into a reservoir, he infects the water supply, and soon one of Bert's friends becomes infected. The friends struggle to stop the contagious, flesh-eating disease while on the run from a group of ornery backwoods locals out for revenge.

programme.title: Is Gold Right for You?
programme.desc: With so much uncertainty surrounding oil, the economy, inflation, and retirement planning, how do you know if gold is right for you?

programme.title: Jersey Shore Star's 6 Pack Surgery
programme.desc: Jersey Shore star undergoes 6-pack surgery! Housewives on drug-spiked cheese? The benefits of cow cuddling? DIY facial! Are women happier with younger men? Autistic man’s amazing weight loss. New fitness trend: crawling emotional support alligator. The fruit you need to eat!

programme.title: Is Breast Implant Illness Real?
programme.desc: Find out why so many women are removing their breast implants. Could breast implant illness be to blame? Are you your own worst enemy? Do you get in your own way? Psychologist Dr. Judy Ho breaks down how to “Stop Self-Sabotage!” Could your favorite Boba drink put you at risk for intestinal blockage? Who says self-care has to be expensive? Find out how to self-care on a budget!

programme.title: Parenting Gone Bad
programme.desc: Continuing with the Parenting 101 series, Dr. Phil talks with parents who may be taking discipline too far! One husband says his wife’s screaming and swearing at their kids is destroying their family. Will sparks fly when Dr. Phil addresses her verbal abuse? Then, meet one mother who uses a spatula to discipline her 6-year-old daughter! Her husband is furious and wants it to stop. Has she crossed the line between discipline and abuse? Plus, a bullying father finds out why his tough love approach may be harming his child.

programme.title: My Annoying Family
programme.desc: Dr. Phil shares advice for dealing with rude, crude and obnoxious behavior from your family members.

programme.title: Moms Biggest Mistakes
programme.desc: If your job description includes long hours, little sleep, and endless requests to open your pocketbook, you must be a mom! Dr. Phil has advice for avoiding some common parenting pitfalls.

programme.title: Domestic Dictators
programme.desc: Are you married to a domestic dictator? Kelly says her controlling husband Grant pushes her to the limit every day, but he says Kelly just isn’t measuring up to his standards. Today, we follow up with one of Dr. Phil’s most talked about couples.

programme.title: New Parenting Styles
programme.desc: Are you a parent who is over- or under-involved in your child's life? Dr. Phil talks with a self-proclaimed Helicopter Mom, a Free-Range mother and two experts to help you find a happy balance while raising your kids. First up, you won't believe what happened to Lori when she let her 10-year-old son walk to soccer practice by himself. Next, meet two moms with opposite parenting approaches: Kristen lets her kids walk to friends' houses on their own and make their own mistakes, while Beckie says she can't imagine letting her kids walk around the neighborhood or even to the school playground unattended. Find out what Dr. Phil thinks. Then, Linda Murray, editor-in-chief of BabyCenter.com and Dr. Michele Borba, a parenting educator and author, share the pros and cons of different parenting styles. And, Dr. Phil checks in with Teresa, who became known as America's Most Over-Protective Mom. Find out if she and her daughter, Ashlee, who's now 18, are getting along better.

programme.title: The Daughters They Lost: Camp Mystic Parents Speak Out
programme.desc: After a July 4th flood kills 27 at a Texas girls’ camp, grieving parents share who their daughters were and why they believe this was a preventable disaster.

programme.title: Part 2: Camp Mystic Parents Demanding Accountability
programme.desc: As lawsuits and new safety laws follow the Camp Mystic tragedy, parents of “Heaven’s 27” demand accountability and changes so no other family endures their loss.

programme.title: Is Gold Right for You?
programme.desc: With so much uncertainty surrounding oil, the economy, inflation, and retirement planning, how do you know if gold is right for you?

programme.title: Bridal Detox Disaster
programme.desc: Is professional honey trapping a good idea? The bride who had a detox drink disaster! Can kimchi be a cure for baldness? Mystery behind exploding nail polish remover! Visit to nail salon sends woman to E.R.! Can expired sunscreen cause burns? Shocking pictures: man with a golf ball sized growth on his head! Can you get sepsis from blisters? Meet the company founders who embrace integrative work lives! Should you go furniture-free for your health? Find out which apples to eat for a longer life!

programme.title: Mom Feeds Children Dog Feces?
programme.desc: Mom accused of feeding her own kids dog feces? ASMR dandruff scraping? Why some are soothed by watching people scrape their scalps! Is elderly drinking on the rise? The medical trend that could be harming your grandparents! Woman celebrates massive excess skin removal! Cauliflower chocolate smoothie? Man’s penis turns to bone? Uncovering singer Camila Cabello's mental health tip is for a stress free day!

programme.title: The Newlywed Show
programme.desc: Statistics say that one out of every two marriages ends in divorce, but you can beat the odds. Dr. Phil spells out the cold hard facts of making a marriage work. We’ll meet a wife who realized soon after her wedding that her husband was not the prince charming she expected. Are there serious problems here or is she just sweating the small stuff? Also, a newlywed couple with a baby finds it hard to spend romantic time together. Dr. Phil shows them how nurturing a marriage is essential and needs to be a priority for the sake of the children.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team has been asked to go to Paddy Reilly's Bar in Manhattan, New York to help explain some after hours activity. Dark shadows have been seen in the basement, voices have been heard, glasses are known to move on their own, and bottles break for no apparent reason. In an upstairs apartment, three men saw an apparition riding a bike, and across the hall a tenant saw a man resembling Gene Hackman peering through a window.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team visits the Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, NJ. This lighthouse has activity reported ranging from untraceable footsteps and doors opening spontaneously, to coughing coming from the keeper's quarters. In the lighthouse itself, people have reported smelling cigar smoke, hearing voices and laughter, and even seeing a persons hand.Jason and Grant start out in the tower, where they hear a possible conversation and footsteps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to The Southern Mansion in Cape May, NJ, and have enlisted the help of Dave Tango's father, Bruce. Bruce has experienced first hand some of the reported activity here; some of it includes glasses dissolving into sand, people being grabbed, a soldier walking through walls, a soldier talking with a woman, and the smell of gardenias. It is believed that the ghost woman could possibly be the niece of the original owner, Esther.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters the TAPS team investigates Preston Castle, a once notorious reform school for boys in Northern California. People have seen apparitions of a man in a white coat in the doctor's office. The infirmary seems to be haunted by a boy that was shot while trying to escape the school. Upstairs there are claims of humming noises, groups of voices, a mist and a woman who claims she was pinched on the butt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to the Grzelak house in Massachusetts where they have been experiencing paranormal activity since the day they moved in 30 years ago. A series of apparitions, shadow people, mysterious voices and even physical attacks have left the Grzelaks desperate for help, to the point where they want to move.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Cape Cod to investigate the Orleans Inn. Some of the claims here are that candles light on their own, glasses slide off tables, hauntings by two separate men who hung themselves, doors opening and closing, and ghosts of naked women. Despite all this, the strangest claim comes from Room 5, where two separate guests have checked in and been driven to insanity inside the room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the home of the Scully family, who are so terrified they are ready to pack up and move. Some of the activities reported in the house are confrontational shadows, spirits breathing down people's necks and, adult legs walking up the stairs. The greatest activity is in the 4-year-old son's bedroom, where he spends his time with the spirits of 2 small children, and talks to them as well as about them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to be invited to investigate Norwich State Hospital, in Norwich, Connecticut. There have been lots of rumors of activity, including moving shadows, haunting faces, screams, moans, and apparitions of children. Excited to start investigating, Jason and Grant start out in the research building and right away they see a moving shadow followed by a strange noise, and faint light in the stairway.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS drives to the Otesaga Resort Hotel in Cooperstown, NY. Employees are terrified by voices calling out to them and doors swinging all on their own. Guests in the hotel also hear non-existent children running the halls and furniture being dragged across the floor upstairs (even on the top floor), while shadows and orbs have been seen and moaning has been heard. Jason and Grant start out in the ballroom, and try to debunk the claim of an orb.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been asked to help the 1875 Inn in Tilton, New Hampshire. The Inn has had two major fires, one of which supposedly took the life of a child named Laura, who now haunts the hotel. One claim is that about 30 people saw a gargoyle-like creature suspended in the air. Another claim is hair being stroked, and there are numerous "Laura" encounters.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the location of the "shot heard round the world" at the Colonial Inn in Concord, Massachusetts. Some of the reported activity includes shadowy figures, people being touched, objects flying off the shelf, and power surges. The history goes all the way back to 1775, when wounded soldiers from the Battle of Concord were brought to the site for medical attention.

programme.title: Palm Beach 2023 Day 2 Part 1
programme.desc: For nearly 50 years, enthusiasts from all over the world have flocked to the Barrett-Jackson collector car auctions, named America's No. 1 Attraction for Car Lovers in the 2019 USA Today Readers? Choice Contest. Widely regarded as a barometer of the collector car industry, the auctions have evolved over the years into world-class automotive lifestyle events where thousands of the world's most sought-after, unique and valuable automobiles cross the block in front of a global audience-- in person and on live national and international television. Barrett-Jackson produces The World's Greatest Collector Car Auctions? in Scottsdale, Arizona; Palm Beach, Florida; Mohegan Sun in Connecticut and Las Vegas, Nevada.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasting enhances the flavor of any kind of meat and Lidia often makes a roast for family meals. Today's menu includes a Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon and Mushrooms; an easy and elegant Roasted Pork Loin with Cabbage and Dried Cherry Sauce; and Roasted Pear, Blueberry and Grape Compote for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich and six special guests at her holiday table: Christopher Walken, Rita Moreno, Ann Curry, Padma Lakshmi, Marcus Samuelsson, and Carlo Ponti, Jr. Hear the personal stories of each individual's journey to and in America, set against a backdrop in which they share a delicious meal that represents the diverse flavors that are part of celebrating the yuletide in New York.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love entertaining and celebrating life with family, friends, and food. Today, Lidia shares recipes that fit any kind of party. She starts with Stewed Savory Peppers, a delicious antipasto, especially when served with lots of grilled or toasted bread. Next, she makes Pear Bellini, a fruity and bubbly cocktail guests can sip on while enjoying antipasti; and who doesn't love fried balls of rice? Lidia shows viewers how to make Rice Balls with Sausage Ragù.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia serves a beautiful Striped Bass with Tomato Pesto over a bed of fennel as the star of the meal. She then creates a tasty dish of Mint String Beans. For dessert, summer is still the theme with Peach Granita, although the granita technique can be be made with all kinds seasonal fruits.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Lidia talks about pasta in her family, it's never "basta!" Today, she creates three new pasta dishes that everyone will love including a Linguine with Swisschard that is made with walnuts and creamy ricotta. She then makes a simple dish of Farfalle with Swordfish, prepared with tomatoes, fresh herbs and capers. And finally, there is nothing better than Lidia's Spaghetti and Meatballs!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Although Italians are not known for a brunch tradition, many of their recipes work beautifully for it. Today's brunch recipes include: Polenta with Honey & Berries; Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta; Rice Balls Stuffed with Sausage Ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a dish that is perfect for family and holiday gatherings. Packed with flavor, this crispy oven baked chicken is bursting with lemon goodness. As a side, she makes a Celery Gratin and a Belgian Walnut Salad.

programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich shares the stories behind the great pantry-inspired recipes that her family has been eating for years--in both good times and challenging ones.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fresh herbs are simply a must in Lidia's kitchen and today she makes three dishes that highlight herbs AND spices. She begins the menu with Pickled Carrots: a quick pickle of tiny carrots packed with the flavors of parsley, garlic and mint; Braised Beef in Guazzetto: rich, braised beef filled with enticing aromas and Skillet Cauliflower with Lemon and Mint: cauliflower florettes showered with lemon juice and a sprinkle of fresh mint.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite desserts-one spoon dessert, one seasonal fruit based dessert and of course a baked sweet to warm up the kitchen. Her Limoncello Tiramisu is a sweet pick-me-up made with delicious limoncello zabaglione. Fruit is a natural as an Italian sweet to end a meal, and she loves to simply serve Grilled Fruit to magnify their natural sweetness. A favorite Italian cookie is the Chocolate Anise Biscotti, made with a shot of espresso.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Zucchini, peas and pancetta risotto; author Katie Parla's capellini and asparagus frittata becomes an involtini alla piazzetta; risotto cakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The beautiful Adriatic Sea was a big part of Lidia's childhood, as she loved to play on the rocky beach and savor the bounty of the local waters. She prepares Linguine with Clams and Broccoli, a twist on the classic linguine con vongole. She then shows three authentically southern Italian styles of topping a piece of crusty bread for her Bruschetta Three Ways- using Mackerel and Burrata, Anchovy and Butter, as well as Broccolini di Rape and Burrata.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and with over 460 varieties made in Italy, it leads to many mouth-watering cheesy recipes. In this episode, Lidia shares her Cheese Baked in a Crust: gorgonzola wrapped with puff pastry and baked as crispy cheesy bites; Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad: a flavorful and fresh mix of celery, artichoke and mortadella; and finally Meatloaf Ricotta: a family favorite meatloaf dish packed with three different cheeses.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares recipes that are quick to whip up and ideal for days when you don't have much time to cook. She starts off by making Green Beans with Mint Pesto, a fresh alternative to the well-known green beans with butter. For a sweet treat, Lidia makes Chunky Cherry Bread Pudding, one of her favorite ways to recycle day-old bread. Next on the menu is Maremma-Style Steak, an impressive steak that anyone can make at home.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America
programme.desc: From jumping the broom to tying the knot, wedding celebrations in America are as diverse as the nation itself, and Lidia cordially invites viewers to be her "plus one" on this cross-country matrimonial odyssey.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia makes pizza the centerpiece for your next party. With a variety of toppings, a salad and dessert, you are ready to go. programme.title: Fight or Flight?
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.desc: Chronicling the life of Indian freedom fighter Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose between Gandhi and Hitler.

programme.title: Adam And Ida - Almost A Fairytale
programme.desc: Separated in the Holocaust, twins Adam and Ida reunite after 53 years - have they finally found each other?

programme.title: Viking Kingdoms
programme.desc: Viking pillage of the Abbey of Lindisfarne in Northubria (England) shocked the Western world.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Ewald von Kleist has broken through to the Terek river, slap in front of the vital oil fields of Grozny and Baku. Only freezing temperatures in the Caucasus prevent von Kleist's 1st Panzer Army from breaking through to Ozoni Kizi and Tbilisi. The Soviets launch a desperate counter-attack that holds the Germans back.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Prefabricated concrete barges are manufactured in preparation for D Day. U.S. troops storm a beach in a practice landing assault. How harbor facilities made in England were used in the Normandy invasion. A storm damages the harbor but unloading continues.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: This issue of The Big Picture depicts the many aspects of our soldiers' daily living in the Korean war zone during the winter period 1952-53. Our Signal Corps combat cameramen give Big Picture viewers a vivid and comprehensive account of activities during this period of operations. This issue shows the people of America what the soldier has gone through during this particular winter period.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, the Nazi Party created the Hitler Youth to indoctrinate children and adolescents with Nazi ideology and prepare them to become a child army for Hitler. This episode traces the rise of the movement, from early everyday life indoctrination, through to the war.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: Airborne troops flood the Netherlands as 50,000 tanks surge from Belgium. However, stronger-than-expected German forces resist fiercely, causing the ambitious operation to falter.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: The draft law of 1940 is passed and American men are inducted into the Army. Large-scale maneuvers are held in 1941. Pearl Harbor is bombed and Franklin Roosevelt asks Congress for a declaration of war.

programme.title: Blood Money - Inside the Soviet Economy
programme.desc: In 1941, as Nazi Germany invaded, the USSR faced collapse. Stalin ordered entire factories moved east by train-steelworks, tank plants, munitions lines. Millions of workers became an army of labor, rebuilding industry and forging weapons far from the front.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: The Fall of Saigon occurred on April 30, 1975 when the South Vietnamese government announced its unconditional surrender to North Vietnam. As a line of tanks smashed through the gates of the presidential palace, Vietcong troops rounded up government soldiers, and raised their red and blue flags. The United States Embassy remained under control of the U.S. Marines.

programme.title: The Death Train
programme.desc: this film revisits the first massive crime of WWII killing 13,000 people in the city of Lasi, Romania that lays out the early stages of the Shoah. This is possible thanks to unique archives - including unpublished photographs - and interviews of the last survivors.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: Major Scheglov analyzes the intelligence report about an enemy column. The pilots discuss a dueling German, but tensions rise. Schugayev faces scrutiny for his report's accuracy. Preparing to escort the Major, the pilots discover sand in the engine. Suspicion falls on the locals. Scheglov holds the mechanic accountable.

programme.title: Late War Fighters of the Luftwaffe
programme.desc: Hitler was losing the war in 1944. In the East, Russians rolled forward relentlessly, threatening the existence of Hitler's Third Reich. Hitler knew that if he were to survive, he needed a miracle. New technologies, or miracle weapons, could turn the tide of war. Against all odds, German engineers not only designed but produced in good numbers some of the best aircraft of the war, the ME262.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 30 January 1933, Hitler became chancellor and the Nazis quickly seized state power. Foreign diplomats in Berlin, turned into spies and whistleblowers, witnessed both Nazi infiltration of high society and the exclusion of Jews. Drawing on rare archives, this documentary reveals their warnings about the rise of National Socialism-and how the world ignored them.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: Evgeniya 'Zhenya' Zvonareva, lead pilot of the female aviation regiment, receives the Order of Kutuzov for destroying Sturmbannführer Neumann's camp. However, the victory owed to friend Galya Shevchenko, once the top night bomber, now demoted to mechanic after tribunal. Zhenya must destroy an enemy ammo-and-fuel depot; a sabotage team led by Captain Aleksandr Makeev will join.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: The first fighter aircraft were flimsy contraptions made up of wood and fabric, flown by men with fast reflexes and deadly determination. How the times have changed. Today's fighter pilot takes control of a machine, which has doubtless cost his country millions of dollars to build.

programme.title: Megapolis: The Ancient World Revealed
programme.desc: Uncover the wonders of Tikal, the ancient Maya city, through groundbreaking 3D graphics. Recently filmed ruins combined with meticulous post production work bring Tikal's splendor to life. From its jungle origins in 8th century BC to its peak with 12,000 structures and iconic temple-pyramids, witness Maya art and ingenuity revived in vibrant detail.

programme.title: The Mystery of Atlit-Yam
programme.desc: In 1984, off Israel's Mediterranean coast, marine archaeologist Ehud Galili discovered an ancient settlement that had been submerged for millennia. The site was at first a mystery, but as underwater excavations progressed, the veil was lifted.

programme.title: The Crimean War
programme.desc: This program looks at the epic charge of the Light Brigade, when a misunderstood Order sent troops straight into the main Russian artillery during the Battle of Balaclava. It also looks at the later Battle of Inkerman and the work of Florence Nightingale.

programme.title: Napoleon Bonaparte: The Russian Campaign
programme.desc: Since his victory over Tsar Alexander in 1807 and the Treaty of Tilsit, France and Russia are officially allies. But Alexander doesn't support Napoleon's expansionist strategy. To Napoleon, Russia's behavior makes it an enemy of France. Ignoring calls for caution, Napoleon invades Russia in 1811.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: Odysseus' fleet tries to avoid Charybdis, the first sea monster ready to swallow them, but Scylla, a horrible multi-headed creature, destroys three of his ships. The last few hours have been grueling, and the sailors want to rest on the island of Helios, which is now in sight.

programme.title: Besieged Fortresses - Legendary Battles
programme.desc: Despite an overwhelming force of 180,000 men, the Ottomans, led by Soliman are unable to shake the fortifications of Rhodes. They then organize a massive maritime blockade and an underground mining mission. Will it be enough to infiltrate the island and defeat the Knights Hospitaller?

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: We all know about Heracles' unequalled strength, and the twelve labours he had to carry out, but we know a great deal less about the way in which his life was turned upside down by a series of terrible curses.

programme.title: Wonders Made By Man - Part 1 and 2
programme.desc: The World abounds with beautiful structures created by mankind - cities, skyscrapers, edifices, memorials, places of worships, pieces of arts and crafts and even jewelry. 'Wonders Made by Man' takes us through a few known and many other completely unknown structures that most of us may never get to witness in person. Parts 1 and 2 visit Tutankhamen, Machu Pichu, Venice, and more!

programme.title: Europe - History Seen From Above
programme.desc: Borders reveal scars of conflict-fortresses, bunkers, fortification lines. Nowhere more than between France and Germany, where frontiers shifted with wars and unions. Once a military line of defense, by the 18th century borders became continuous demarcations shaped by rivers and relief. Over time, the Franco-German frontier transformed from a battleground into a fragile line of peace.

programme.title: Decoding da Vinci
programme.desc: 500 years after his death, Leonardo da Vinci's painting is still just as fascinating. And yet, there are only 16 surviving canvasses attributed to him, some of which are unfinished. Through analysis of infrared reflectography, a technique that reveals the drawing beneath the layer of paint, the film underlines the prowess of da Vinci's work and captures its meaning and emotion.

programme.title: Ancient Megacities
programme.desc: Explore the transformation of a humble village into a formidable ancient city atop Turkey's Hissarlik hill. Despite being rebuilt nine times after fires and earthquakes, Troy remains a masterpiece of defensive architecture. Archaeologists continue to uncover its secrets, inspired by the epic tale of the Iliad. Yet, the mystery persists: how did the Mycenaeans penetrate Troy's impregnable defenses?

programme.title: Castles & Palaces of Europe
programme.desc: The Palacio da Pena dominates Lisbon and the Atlantic coast with its eclectic Moorish- and Rococo-influenced architecture. The library, inside the Palacio Nacional de Mafra, contains over 4,000 works. The red façade of the Palace of the Marquis of Fronteira, which survived the earthquake that destroyed Lisbon in 1755, conceals splendid azulejos, tile panels painted in shades of blue.

programme.title: The Egyptian Mummies - Immortality Unwrapped
programme.desc: From the Valley of the Kings to the tomb of Tutankhamun, archaeologists and scientists explore how Egypt's rulers used mummification to secure divine power. Cutting-edge analysis of royal burials reveals the secrets of embalming, political intrigue, and the eternal quest for immortality.

programme.title: The Secret Garden: Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace EP.1 <1>
programme.desc: Nakseonjae combines noble residence style with palace architecture, featuring unique decorative patterns that showcase late Joseon craftsmanship. Enjoy a break at the exclusive Rear Garden of Nakseonjae in Changdeokgung Palace.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Autumn Forest of the Royal Tombs: With Queen Inhyeon's Tears, SeoOReung <19>
programme.desc: Named for its five royal tombs, Seoreung in Goyang is the second-largest royal tomb cluster of the Joseon Dynasty. Explore its vast, well-preserved natural forest paths, known as "Shinrim" (Divine Forest).(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Autumn Forest of the Royal Tombs: Connecting Mother and Son, Taereung and Gangneung <18>
programme.desc: Located in Seoul, Taereung is the resting place of Queen Munjeong, while Gangneung is for her son, King Myeongjong, and his wife, Queen Insun. The two tombs, belonging to mother and son, are connected by a serene forest path.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving Blessings into Rice Cake Mold: Wood Carving Master <63>
programme.desc: Delicate patterns carved into small wooden molds are more than decorations—they carry heartfelt wishes for good fortune. The sound of carving reveals the timeless devotion behind traditional confections.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Legacy of Joseon Ceramics: Porcelain Master <23>
programme.desc: The Baeksan family is a traditional prestigious family that has continued Korean ceramics for over 300 years since the era of King Yeongjo of Joseon Dynasty, greatly supported by the efforts of son Kim Kyung-sik, and grandson Kim Ji-Hoon.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Flowering Devotion: Shoe Making Master <65>
programme.desc: Traditional Korean shoes, delicately stitched petal by petal, are more than footwear—they embody beauty, craftsmanship, and heartfelt wishes. Each step in their making reflects generations of devotion passed down through time.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving for the Sacred: Metal Engraving Master <59>
programme.desc: Metal carving, a tradition rooted in the Bronze Age, lives on in the intricate patterns engraved onto sarira reliquaries. Each hammer strike reflects the artisan’s devotion, preserving the sacred through centuries of skill.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Drops of Crimson Tears: Brewing Red Liquor <76>
programme.desc: Grains, yeast, and the patience of time come together to create deep crimson liquor. Distilled in the traditional way, Jindo Hongju carries the warmth of the land and the devotion of its maker.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Embodying Wishes in Paper: Jihwa Master <43>
programme.desc: Jihwa has been used not only in the royal court but also in family celebrations, Buddhist ceremonies, and shamanic rituals since ancient times. A Jihwa master is an artisan who cuts and decorates paper to create adornments for ceremonies.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Traditional Winter Tea Table: Royal Confectionery Winter Table <4>
programme.desc: Sit in the warm ondol room with thick rice cakes (Duteopddeok) and sweet Gaeseong Yakgwa, and enjoy a warm cup of Sujeonggwa. Feel the warmth of winter.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Soaring Squid: Jeolla Province Ritual Food Master <72>
programme.desc: In southern Korea, a dried squid transforms into a phoenix on the ritual table. This delicate food art, rooted in care and reverence, embodies the spirit and blessing of traditional ceremonies.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Welcome Spring: Royal Confectionery Spring Table <1>
programme.desc: Capturing the perfect snack that matches spring best, the sounds of making royal confectionery. Experience the taste and style filled with the scent of spring.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Enduring the Summer Heat: Mat Weaving <57>
programme.desc: In the sweltering summer, hands weave coolness from strands of sedge. Each mat, boiled, dried, and tightly woven, holds the wisdom of tradition and the breath of community.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Making Ink with Soot: Ink Master <36>
programme.desc: Ink, one of the Four Treasures of the Study (ink, paper, brush, inkstone), has been a companion of scholars since ancient times. Welcome to the world of the ink master.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.desc: Eduardo descubre que Artemio planea deshacerse de Liliana. Damián le asegura a Vladimir que Priscila no es una buena mujer. Fernanda descubre que Camilo intentó abusar de Aurora.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 23
programme.desc: Dominga le confirma a Fermín la hipótesis que tiene sobre la identidad de Esmeralda. Fátima reprende a Graciela por su affaire y pone un plan en marcha. Rodolfo manda a que Esmeralda y sus allegados abandonen la choza en la que viven.

programme.title: Mañana Es Para Siempre Capítulo 140
programme.desc: Erika sufre al saber que Fernanda es amante de Eduardo. Fernanda lleva a cabo sus planes para evitar que Bárbara le haga daño a Aurora. Venus idea un plan para demostrarle a Natasha que Camilo la está engañando.

programme.title: Esmeralda Capítulo 24
programme.desc: En medio de un forcejeo, Dominga cae al piso y pierde el conocimiento, Esmeralda se estremece al hallarla desfallecida. José Armando tiene un enfrentamiento con su padre, Rodolfo le da un ultimátum si no termina la relación con Esmeralda.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 13
programme.desc: Santiago y Camila lloran juntos su desventura, pero entienden que no pueden hacer nada. Rita se entera que Camila volvió y se pone furiosa. Mercedes muere y Ricardo piensa cumplir su promesa de exigir sus bienes. Alberto le ofrece matrimonio a Úrsula.

programme.title: Tres Veces Ana Capítulo 54
programme.desc: Marcelo amenaza a Samuel y él acepta ser su abogado. Tras discutir con Ana Leticia, Ana Laura cae por las escaleras. Ana Laura le cuenta a Ramiro que Valentín busca vengarse de él. Ramiro y Ana Laura le entregan a Ernestina la pulsera de Ana Lucía.

programme.desc: Santiago, entrenador de tenis, pierde su trabajo porque María lo acusa de acosar sexualmente a su hijo. Por culpa de Ángel, la policía le incauta un dinero falso y con rastros de coca a Nicole.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis le exige el divorcio a José porque se fue de viaje y le ocultó que su madre le pegó a los niños. Daniela exige que Esteban se someta a una terapia para eliminar su fetiche de voyerista.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tony cree que los videos de Alejandra para cazar un Sugar Daddy son su perdición. Jaqueline autoriza la desconexión de un hombre hospitalizado, pero este resultó ser el padre de otra persona.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paola exige que Tatiana le pague la renta o desaloje su casa, pero ella pagó a la inmobiliaria. La novia de Nahuel le pone una visa "fiancé" y se la niegan porque la ex, Elizabeth, tenía otra.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrea pide 15 mil dólares y orden de alejamiento para Jessica, quien le dio testosterona. Roxana exige que su ex retire de internet los videos que publicó para probar que era un cornudo feliz.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Exige el divorcio, su esposo la engañó con la amante y extrajo dinero de la cuenta, según ella, para matar a su difunto padre. A Juliana le cancelan el contrato porque creen que no es mujer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carmen recupera a su hija, pero Lucía y Alejandro insisten en que la niña estaba mejor bajo sus cuidados. No quiere que su anciana madre practique la kunyaza, una técnica de placer sexual.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Quiere ser la guardiana del amigo de su hijo para llenar el espacio que él dejó al morir. Escapa para evitar ser descubierto y se lesiona, ahora no puede practicar su pasión: el paracaidismo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La boda entre Jenifer y su novio se cancela, pero ella se niega a devolver el anillo de compromiso. Teresa contrata a John como enfermero, una inyección demostró que él es un farsante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carlos y John quieren adoptar a las gemelas de Orlando, quienes se quedaron sin mamá. Además, despiden a Zuli del bar donde trabajaba porque no supo comportarse durante una fiesta fetiche.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La madre de Eduardo está en vida vegetal y ahora su padre reaparece para recuperar a la familia. Por otro lado, Fernando descubre que su ex involucra a su niño en estafas de seguros de autos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gilberto es menor de edad y se casa, sin permiso, con una mujer mucho mayor que él. Además, Leo y Pikete son dos "influencers" que sostienen una rivalidad para ver quién tiene mayor alcance.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Franco es policía y demanda a su ex Johana porque ella finge el secuestro de sus hijos para huir de sus maltratos. Exagente de ICE deporta a su papá, ahora quiere hacer lo mismo con su hermano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Arlet pide el divorcio de Víctor, él tiene otras mujeres a quienes obliga a comportarse como si fuesen perras. Sofía vive en una tribu de madres solteras, el padre de su hijo exige la custodia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: A Talía la botan de la casa por enseñar a la hija de Jeny a bailar y a cobrar por hacerlo. Annette demanda a Angélica, dueña del hogar de ancianos donde su madre se enamoró de otra mujer.

programme.desc: Tim negocia con Aurelio para impedir el paso del uranio. Leonor queda fuera del caso Casillas.

programme.desc: Casillas se enfrenta al Tijeras para cobrarle el asesinato de Chacorta, mientras se salva de la muerte a manos de aliados de Marcado. Julia busca a Leonor para que ayude a Tim.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim y Rivero atacan al Chema, mientras Marcado y Medardo asaltan el búnker para matar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas mata a Medardo, y Marcado huye para ayudar al Chema luego de que Tim y Rivero incautan el uranio. Tijeras también escapa, mientras Mónica acepta la condición de Omar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor golpea a Casillas, lo deja herido y amenaza con matarlo: ahora sabe que sexo y muerte van de la mano. Mónica y Rutila ya tienen su propio negocio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas busca a Mónica, pero ella lo rechaza y le dice que se aleje de su hijo, mientras el Chema amenaza a Rutila. Tijeras convence a Marcado y se escapan a Colombia en un avión del Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas sorprende a su familia, pero Irma lo acusa de haber entregado a Chacorta a cambio de su libertad. Rutila recibe la carta de Ernesto, mientras el Chema le exige que seduzca a Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim le pide a Casillas que le envíe un cargamento de droga a Chicago, pero él no tiene ni mercancía ni dinero para volver a montar su red de narcotráfico. Leonor ve de nuevo a Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas jura ante la tumba de Chacorta que vengará su muerte, y acusa a Irma de ser la culpable por convencerlo de dejar el negocio. Prepara una coartada para llevar a cabo su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio mata a Irma, y hace ver que murió en el ataque de la Policía y la Marina al rancho de Sinaloa. Logran escapar del tiroteo, pero Chabela queda malherida. Feyo promete enviar la droga.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor llora la muerte de Chabela y de sus hijos, mientras Casillas le plantea la venganza. Tim trata de convencer a Rivero de que Aurelio no estaba en Sinaloa. Leonor busca olvidar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor le dice a Aurelio que acepta entrar en el negocio para vengar la muerte de Chabela y sus hijos, y le entrega el dinero de la venta del ganado. Mónica le exige al Chema que se aleje.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas intenta seducir a la Condesa, quien le coquetea, pero asegura que es fiel a Feyo. Víctor quiere comenzar su venganza y matar al que dio el pitazo de que estaba en el rancho de Sinaloa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor viaja con Aurelio a Chicago para entregar la droga a Tim, y crecen sus sospechas sobre el Espanto. Rutila visita a Ernesto y le miente, mientras doña Alba la compara con su padre.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Gamer
programme.desc: Each week Kable, a death-row inmate, battles his fellow prisoners in a violent online game called "Slayers," his every move controlled by a young gamer's remote device. To the players, Kable and the other inmates are just simulated characters. But, to a resistance group that opposes the game's inventor, Kable is a critical component of their plan to end the inventor's form of high-tech slavery.

programme.title: Kin
programme.desc: While scavenging for copper wire, Detroit teenager Eli Solinski stumbles upon a high-tech gun that holds special powers. When his brother, Jimmy, lands in trouble with a local crime boss, the two siblings take the mysterious weapon and go on the run. Eli and Jimmy now find themselves in a life-and-death battle against an army of thugs and two heavily armored, futuristic soldiers who want their gun back.

programme.title: Latency
programme.desc: An agoraphobic gamer agrees to test new equipment that uses AI to interpret the electrical activity of her brain. Soon, the line between reality and her subconscious starts to blur as she wonders if the device is serving a sinister force.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward a collision course with Earth. With only weeks before impact, NASA executive Jacinda "Jo" Fowler teams up with a man from her past and a conspiracy theorist for an impossible mission into space to save humanity.

programme.title: Source Code
programme.desc: Helicopter pilot Colter Stevens (Jake Gyllenhaal) is part of a top-secret military operation that enables him to experience the last few minutes in the life of Sean Fentress, a man who died in a commuter-train explosion. The purpose of Colter's mission is to learn the identity of the bomber and prevent a similar catastrophe. As Colter lives Sean's final moments, he becomes more certain that he can prevent the first tragedy from occurring -- as long as he doesn't run out of time.

programme.title: Den of Thieves
programme.desc: Nick O'Brien is the hard-drinking leader of the Regulators, an elite unit of the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department. Ray Merrimen is the recently paroled leader of the Outlaws, a gang of ex-military men who use their expertise and tactical skills to evade the law. O'Brien, Merrimen and their crews soon find themselves on a direct collision course as the criminals hatch an elaborate plan for a seemingly impossible heist -- the city's Federal Reserve Bank.

programme.title: The Mist
programme.desc: After a powerful storm damages their Maine home, David Drayton (Thomas Jane) and his young son head into town to gather food and supplies. Soon afterward, a thick fog rolls in and engulfs the town, trapping the Draytons and others in the grocery store. Terror mounts as deadly creatures reveal themselves outside, but that may be nothing compared to the threat within, where a zealot (Marcia Gay Harden) calls for a sacrifice.

programme.title: The Crazies
programme.desc: Anarchy reigns when an unknown toxin turns the peaceful citizens of Ogden Marsh into bloodthirsty lunatics. In an effort to contain the spread of the infection, authorities blockade the town and use deadly force to keep anyone from getting in or out. Now trapped among killers, Sheriff Dutton and his wife and two companions must band together to find a way out before madness and death overtake them.

programme.title: Cabin Fever

Panicking, he abandons the scene and leaves the man for dead. When the man stumbles into a reservoir, he infects the water supply, and soon one of Bert's friends becomes infected. The friends struggle to stop the contagious, flesh-eating disease while on the run from a group of ornery backwoods locals out for revenge.

programme.title: Choke Point; Laser Focus; Growing Up Behind Walls
programme.desc: Iran's chokehold on the Strait of Hormuz, one of the most important shipping channels in the world; counter-drone laser systems; an orphanage in Port-au-Prince, Haiti, where children have been sheltered from the violence for more than four years.

programme.title: Crime, Capture & Ransom
programme.desc: 60 Minutes reports on the capture of Boston mobster, James "Whitey" Bulger, and his girlfriend, Catherine Greig, investigates problems at some of America's cemeteries and interviews Jessica Buchanan, the American humanitarian aid worker who was working in Somalia when she was kidnapped by Somali pirates.

programme.title: Bill Whitaker Reports: Space
programme.desc: 60 Minutes reports on the effects of carbon dioxide on climate change, and examines the impact of the reintroduction of wolves to Yellowstone National Park by the U.S. Park Service.

programme.title: Iran's Assassin; The Heritage War; Horse Racing Reform?
programme.desc: Iran's use of proxy assassins to silence or eliminate critics of the regime in the U.S. and Europe; Russia's deliberate destruction and looting of Ukraine's museums, churches and monuments; the national regulator tasked with cleaning up horse racing.

programme.title: Ukraine-US; Death Flights
programme.desc: Scott Pelley speaks with members of Congress who argue America should not abandon Ukraine; flight logs found in a plane in Fort Lauderdale, Fla., uncover Argentina's notorious death flights during its dictatorship in the mid-1970s.

programme.title: Childhood in a Changing World
programme.desc: 60 Minutes reports on the introduction of a new, autistic Muppet character on the television series Sesame Street, examines how tablet computers are enabling autistic people to communicate freely, and reports on a study by the National Institutes of Health on the effects of heavy screen-time on the developing brains of adolescents.

programme.title: Overtime: AI chatbots raise safety concerns for children, experts warn
programme.desc: Research shows that AI chatbots like Character AI can be harmful to children. Here's what Sharyn Alfonsi learned when she talked with a chatbot modeled after herself.

programme.title: America and the War in Ukraine
programme.desc: 60 Minutes interviews President Joe Biden at the White House and in Detroit, and reports on Kherson, Ukraine, one of the first major Ukrainian cities captured in the war with Russia.

programme.title: NIH; Evidence; The Land of Declining Sons
programme.desc: Dr. Francis Collins, former director of the National Institutes of Health; new evidence emerges that could change one's understanding of the 9/11 terrorist attacks; Japan's demographic changes are affecting the country and its culture.

programme.title: Artists and Tastemakers
programme.desc: America's #1 news program and most successful TV news magazine.

60 Minutes interviews some of the children who lost a parent in the 9/11 terrorist attacks, goes beneath ground zero at the World Trade Center where a dangerous cleanup job was taking place, and interviews Vice President Richard Cheney in the wake.

programme.title: Overtime: Reclaiming the 9/11 Dead
programme.desc: The ongoing process of identifying the remains of 9/11 victims; honoring the nation's promise to never forget.

programme.title: Wine
programme.desc: 60 Minutes reports on resveratrol, a substance in red wine that scientists believe might extend life by preventing a number of age-related illnesses, and reports on the effects of climate change on wine production.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is invited to Lemp Mansion in St. Louis, Missouri. There have been tragic deaths at this mansion with the patriarch and three of his children taking their own lives. There are reported feelings of uneasiness in 'the office,' which is where William Lemp committed suicide. The bar area was once the bedroom of Charles Lemp, who killed his dog and then himself it's said that people see him walking around with his dog at his side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate the abandoned Milton School in Alton, Ill. where some students are said to still be walking through the halls. In the 1930's a young student named Mary was killed at the school, and the janitor who was the prime suspect then committed suicide inside the building. There are claims that people feel a child holding their hand and smell bubble gum.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Ohio and to the Thurber house, the home of author James Thurber, who wrote The Night the Ghost Got In based off his paranormal experiences there. The house's history is checkered; for starters, it was built on top of where an insane asylum once stood. Seven women died - a man killed his wife and then himself. Lights turn themselves on and off, people have seen apparitions and heard footsteps, and a clock spontaneously comes to life.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters TAPS returns to Mansfield, Ohio to investigate the Bissman Building, where the current manager, Ellis Byrd, was nearly choked to death by a black mist. The Bissman Building has been in his family for five generations, and has its fair share of paranormal activity. Many believe the activity started in 1911 following a violent death where an employee was decapitated by the building's elevator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS starts out at the Ulster County Jail in Kingston, NY, where inmates and personal have both witnessed activity. The claims there range from objects moving on their own to ghosts talking to people. A ghost with hollowed out eyes and long white hair confronted a guard, and another guard was poked in the head by one of the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Beardslee Castle in Little Falls, NY, which is a home turned into a restaurant/ bar that has lots of interesting claims. Some of these claims include screams, voices, doors opening, singing, and a lady who forms standing next to a window. Steve and Grant get started on the door that opens on its own in the kitchen. Steve starts to open a nearby door and sure enough, the other door opens forcefully as well. Debunked!

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Fort William Henry located in Lake George, New York, where Ghost Hunters Academy winner Adam Berry joins the team. Before the team heads out, we learn that Kris and Britt will be joining the GHI team and heading to Eastern Europe. The fort was built in 1755. During the French and Indian War, local Native American tribes defeated the British, killing over 1,000 people.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads south to Atlanta, Georgia to investigate Rhodes Hall, where they will be joined by the stars of the Real Housewives of Atlanta, NeNe Leakes, Sheree Whitfield, and Kim Zolciak. Traci Clark, the Hall's communications director, tells the team about the history and the activity that has been reported. Amos Rhodes built the home in 1904, and his family resided there for 20 years, before Amos passed away in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS gets into the Christmas spirit at New Hampshire's Christmas Farm Inn. Gary Plourde, the owner, gives the guys the tour and shares some of the reported activity. The stories range from apparitions and footsteps, to the sounds of children playing and the feeling of being watched. Jason and Grant start out the night in the Carriage House spa and start to hear some footsteps around them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates the entire town of Alexandria, Louisiana, where paranormal activity seems to lurk around every corner. The first stop on their paranormal tour is the Hotel Bentley, where among other reports, disembodied conversations are heard, and a little girl trips people on the stairs. The next stop is Finnegan's Wake Tavern, where there are reports of shadows moving, loud bangs coming from upstairs, and a glass breaking on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Chester County, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennhurst Asylum. Pennhurst was forcibly shut down in 1986 for mistreatment of patients, overcrowding and abuse. Some of the claims are screams being heard, people being pushed, doors opening and closing on their own, shadows, and apparitions.

programme.title: Fight or Flight?
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: The Dictator
programme.desc: Hidden in archives and private collections, images of the Third Reich have also been preserved - in colour.

programme.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
programme.desc: End of the 1930s, in Occupied Europe. From one day to the next, young men, women and their families found themselves excluded, persecuted, hunted down and arrested, simply for being Jewish. They would soon be deported far from home, to a place that became the ultimate symbol of horror: Auschwitz, Nazi Germany's largest concentration and extermination camp.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Hitler, Göring, and Himmler shared a strange obsession with animals, using them as propaganda tools, symbols of ideology, and even weapons of war. Far beyond affection, their fascination fueled pseudo-scientific projects and genetic manipulation. Through archives, expert insight, and re-enactments, this documentary uncovers how the Nazis exploited nature to serve their brutal vision.

programme.title: WWII: The Price of Empire
programme.desc: The war was started solely by Germany's and Japan's acts of aggression. But in 1944 they are being driven from the lands that they had conquered and are being pressured to an act of unconditional surrender.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: As the last Nazi offensive of the war develops, the vicious SS Panzer divisions leading the attack resort to murder, a dangerous fifth column slips into the American camp causing chaos and confusion, and the desperate defence of a key Belgian town seems doomed.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Wars in the Middle East Collection
programme.desc: Iraq's 1990 invasion of Kuwait resulted in more than one million troops facing off against each other in the desert of the Persian Gulf. The Allied Coalition's air war, known as Operation Desert Storm, involved the most sophisticated technological weaponry available.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: The 3rd Battalion, Ninth Marines wading ashore 10 miles west of Da Nang in March 1965 marked the beginning of the Corps commitment to the war in Vietnam. This is the story of why they were called in and their first actions against the Viet Cong. The Battalions initial orders read in part ...to conduct security missions, reconnaissance operations, and offensive operations as directed.

programme.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
programme.desc: On June 6, 1944, the Normandy Landings, officially called Operation Overlord, began. This massive battle was also the largest media operation ever, with hundreds of reporters capturing footage under heavy fire. Among the first waves on beaches like Juno, Omaha, and Utah, these brave photographers shaped our collective visual memory of World War II.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: While Hitler faced frustrations on all fronts, and the Japanese were kept at bay by the Americans, despite heavy US casualties, the Allied leaders faced a new challenge. Although Churchill and Roosevelt had always been comfortable working together, the Russian leader Joseph Stalin had in the past been regarded more as a foe than a friend.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As winter gave way to spring the world watched and waited as the Allied forces prepared for Operation Overlord. Brave and daring, risking all, US General Dwight D Eisenhower took charge of the campaign to deliver the fight directly to Adolf Hitler.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: French civilians and U.S. Army engineers repair and salvage railroad yards, bridges, and trains.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Amphibious training in England and the invasion of France at Omaha Beach.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Roosevelt, Churchill, and Stalin congregate at the Teheran Conference in 1943. U.S. troops land and fight on Kwajalein, Eniwetok, Saipan, Guam, and other Pacific islands. Russian troops advance to Romania and capture German soldiers. Paratroops jump at Caen. Citizens of Rome, Paris, Bucharest, Brussels, Belgrade, and Athens celebrate their liberation. F.D.R. addresses the United Nations.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: The episode explains the American capture of Strasbourg from the Germans followed by the German surprise attack on the Battle of the Bulge.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: June 22, 1941. Under the code name 'Barbarossa', Nazi Germany invaded the Soviet Union. In the first hours of the attack, bombs rained down on Soviet airfields on the frontier, opening the way for the Panzer division and definitely breaking the German-Soviet non-aggression Pact, signed two years earlier. For the Soviets, it was a complete surprise...

programme.title: Sinking Nazi Battleships: Bismarck & Tirpitz
programme.desc: When the Nazi Battleship Bismarck was launched it was destined to be one of the greatest battleships that ever took to sea. After it sunk the thought to be unsinkable HMS Hood, Winston Churchill uttered just three words - Sink the Bismarck.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: The men of the 283rd Medical Attachment, providing air ambulance support in Vietnam.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: The last episode of the series Eternal Egypt ventures into the desert that the Egyptians of the Nile have never really managed to control. It is still today the place of all dangers and rebellion.

programme.title: Ships That Changed the World
programme.desc: The arrival of menacing German U-Boats in international waters rewrote the rulebook on maritime conflict, and so Britain began rapidly converting its merchant vessels into battleships. Sea battles such as those at Cornell and Jutland saw the two empire's differing approaches put to the test - pitting Germany's sub-surface sneak attacks and strong defenses against Britain's brute force.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In this world, evil lurks in both shadows and unassuming places. It deceives and destroys. When Bonnie's family buys a 19th-century Connecticut farmhouse, they feel watched. After unseen entities attack her children, they seek out psychic investigators. As events grow violent, Bonnie forms a psychic link to the past, and investigators witness the haunting escalate from obsession to possession.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In life, people can be tormented by their own crimes. The same may be true in death. In Wilder, Kentucky, a nightclub stands by the Licking River, said to draw murderers and Satanists. Club owner Bobby Mackey dismisses the legends-until his wife and an employee are attacked by unseen forces. Beneath the club, an old slaughterhouse well harbors an ancient evil, waiting to claim its next victims.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Living together requires balance, but Mike and Lisa aren't alone in their new home. Lisa's behavior changes inexplicably, and Mike grows desperate for answers. A late-night encounter with an invisible force convinces him they are haunted. He sets up surveillance, watching and waiting. What he captures shakes him to the core-are ghosts real, or is he losing his mind?

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: In Taiwan, many believe the spiritual and material worlds are intertwined. When an American family moves into a lavish mansion in the Yangmingshan Mountains, they witness disturbing supernatural events. Skeptical at first, they refuse to believe in ghosts-until their youngest daughter becomes possessed. A Taoist priest reveals the house was designed to empower the dead and torment the living.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Psychics claim to see the past as if it were unfolding before them. When Suzanna Hadwin visits the Wheatsheaf Pub in North England, she encounters a long-buried mystery. The owners hear whispers and find strange handprints, leading them to use a Ouija board. Their search uncovers evidence of an old murder-hidden behind the very walls of the pub, which soon turns against them.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: The Fahey family has lived in their Galway townhouse for decades. When Martha brings home her newborn, eerie disturbances begin. Unexplained cries echo through the night, objects vanish, and a chilling presence fills the house. A priest offers no relief, but a healer reveals a dark secret-Martha's child has awakened the psychic energy of a long-buried crime that prayer alone cannot erase.

programme.title: Europe - History Seen From Above
programme.desc: The White Cliffs of Dover long signaled Britain's frontier. By the first millennium, the land was a patchwork of rival kingdoms. The Norman conquest of 1066 changed everything, ushering in an age of castles and fortresses that asserted both power and protection. These enduring monuments testify to centuries of conquest and the long forging of four nations under one flag.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: In Saqqara desert, south of Cairo, stands a little-known monument whose walls are covered with exceptional texts: the pyramid of Pepi II - Egypt's longest reigning pharaoh. Its funerary chambers house the oldest collection of religious texts in the world! Experts are now able to scan the structure in the hope to solve its many enigmas.

programme.title: The Egyptians
programme.desc: For years, Egyptologists sought Cleopatra's tomb, a treasure yet undiscovered. But a recent find offers hope-a mummified hand, claimed to be hers, surfaced in an American collector's possession. International experts join forces, tracing the relic's journey from excavation sites to DNA labs. Through exclusive investigation, the film aims to unveil the 2,000-year-old mystery of Cleopatra.

programme.title: George III: The Genius of the Mad King
programme.desc: After 200 years under lock and key, all the personal papers of one of our most important monarchs are seeing the light of day for the first time. In the first documentary to gain extensive access to the Royal Archives, Robert Hardman sheds fascinating new light on George III, Britain's longest-reigning king.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths: The Odyssey
programme.desc: In Ithaca, Queen Penelope endures the presence of Suitors who covet her hand, and the throne of her husband Odysseus - who disappeared more than 10 years ago.
