programme.title: Life Immersed in Sound: Jeju Folk Songs <7>
programme.desc: Jeju folk songs are songs sung to overcome the hard labor of Jeju people’s lives. Enjoy the Jeju folk songs imbued with their life and emotions.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Continuing Tradition and Taste: Making Jang <14>
programme.desc: Korean ancestors believed that the taste of Korean food is determined by the quality of Jang (fermented sauces), and without good Jang, there can’t be good food. Experience the deep taste through traditional Jang making.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Coloring with Lacquer: Color Lacquer Painting Master <66>
programme.desc: Natural pigments layered over lacquer create vivid colors that endure for generations. Each stroke, dried and painted again with care, reveals the quiet precision and artistry of Korea’s traditional lacquer painting.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Drawing with Fire: Nakhwajang <20>
programme.desc: Nakhwajang is a traditional art form where pictures and letters are burned onto surfaces using a heated iron on charcoal. Appreciate the traditional Korean ink wash painting and the art of Nakhwajang.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Echoes of a Thousand Years: Musical Instrument Master <64>
programme.desc: At the heart of Korean rhythm is the janggu, the traditional hourglass drum. From wood shaping to skin tightening, each step carries a legacy of sound and craftsmanship.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Brush Made with Soul: Brush Master <37>
programme.desc: A brush master is an artisan who makes brushes, one of the Four Treasures of the Study. The quality of the hair is the most important aspect of making a brush. Feel the dedication of the brush master.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Magic of Making Paper that Lasts a Thousand Years: Making Hanji <55>
programme.desc: The process of making Hanji involves cutting, steaming, boiling, drying, peeling, re-boiling, pounding, mixing, scooping, and drying mulberry trees, undergoing 99 meticulous touches. Explore the dedicated process of 'Hanji making'.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Carving Gentle Light: Jade Crafting <24>
programme.desc: Jade has long been treasured as a symbol of virtue in Eastern culture. In the hands of a master artisan, raw jade is selected, shaped, and polished into refined beauty. Each carving reveals not only technique, but the quiet elegance of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Welcome Spring: Royal Confectionery Spring Table <1>
programme.desc: Capturing the perfect snack that matches spring best, the sounds of making royal confectionery. Experience the taste and style filled with the scent of spring.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Korea’s Representative Food Culture: Making Kimchi <32>
programme.desc: Kimchi, a representative food of Korea! Did you know that our kimchi-making culture is listed by UNESCO? Learn the tradition of making kimchi.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Full of Sensations: Royal Confectionery Tea Table <2>
programme.desc: Let’s make a tea table full of sensations! Experience various delicacies filled with dedication and handmade taste, such as mugwort rice cake balls (Ssukguridan) and twisted flour dough flower rice cakes.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Artistic Peak of Knotting: Knot Master <50>
programme.desc: Knot Masters are artisans who use strings to make various types of knots and tassels. Appreciate the works of Knot Masters who have reached the height of art in Dahoe knot making.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Peaceful Mudflats: Reed Swaying in the Wind, Suncheon Bay <7>
programme.desc: Located on the southern coast, Suncheon Bay features stunning reed fields and Salicornia (glasswort) colonies. It is home to diverse tidal flat creatures and rare birds like the black-faced spoonbill.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Mystical Hidden Scenery: Jusanji Pond, Cheongsong EP.4 <12>
programme.desc: Completed in 1720, Jusanji Pond is fed by clear waters from Byeolbawi Rock and surrounded by lush forests of Juwangsan Mountain, creating a serene, otherworldly atmosphere.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Way of the Scholar: Nakjukjangdo <46>
programme.desc: Jangdo is a small knife carried on the body for daily use, self-defense, or as an ornament. Nakjukjangdo is a traditional knife made using the Nakjuk technique. Appreciate Nakjukjangdo, used while walking the path of scholars.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: A Bowl Made by the Sea: Tongyeong Neomul Bibimbap <35>
programme.desc: There are various regional versions of traditional bibimbap, but Tongyeong's version is accompanied by tofu soup. Experience the special bibimbap of Tongyeong.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Blooming from Paper: Traditional Jihwa <58>
programme.desc: Cut, folded, and twisted into bloom, these paper flowers hold layers of sincerity and hope. Once adorning palaces and sacred spaces, jihwa blossoms again in the hands of devoted artisans. Let the soft rustle of paper whisper the timeless breath of tradition.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Abundant Tea Table: Royal Confectionery Autumn Table <3>
programme.desc: Enjoy the taste of the bountiful autumn with the perfect royal confectionery autumn table, filled with abundant fruit flower rice cakes.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Overcoming Time of Patience: Selecting Hairs <52>
programme.desc: In the traditional brush-making process, the process of selecting hairs, known as 'Jeongmo work,' is essential for creating a quality brush. Let's appreciate the artisan enduring the time of patience through thousands of repetitions.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

It is home to diverse tidal flat creatures and rare birds like the black-faced spoonbill.(Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Fuga de El Chapo
programme.desc: El líder del cártel de Sinaloa se fuga por segunda vez de una prisión federal en México. Sigue la búsqueda de Joaquín Guzmán Loera, en esta historia se tiene acceso total al lugar de donde se fugó ‘El Chapo’ después de un año y cuatro meses.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Misterio al final del túnel
programme.desc: El escándalo de la fuga de Joaquín Guzmán quien escapó de una celda de 3 x 2 metros y que logró burlar los sistemas de seguridad de la prisión del Altiplano.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - ¿Sabes lo que comes?
programme.desc: Los peligros que existen en los alimentos que consumimos día con día, los diferentes problemas de salud que podemos encontrar con una mala alimentación.Según los expertos, existen varias alternativas para llevar una vida sana.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Curvas y armas 'Las Buchonas'
programme.desc: Una vida llena de cirugías plásticas, lujos, excesos y armas; mujeres jóvenes y ambiciosas que están dispuestas a todo por tener una buena vida.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Mutilados
programme.desc: Personas con capacidades diferentes cuentan sus historias de lo que ha sido viajar a bordo de ‘La bestia’. Una esperanza de llegar a La Casa Blanca es lo que tienen ‘los mutilados’.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - 36 Horas
programme.desc: Una familia con una vida normal cambia de la noche a la mañana cuando el pequeño Oliver es diagnosticado con una agresiva enfermedad. Los padres de Oliver son notificados y comienza el calvario de 36 horas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Recaptura de El Chapo
programme.desc: Teresa Rodríguez relata la historia de la recaptura de Joaquín Guzmán Loera 'El Chapo'. Desde el escape de 'El Chapo' junto con 'El Cholo' de la casa en Culiacán hasta la captura de ambos delincuentes en un hotel de paso.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Reencuentros
programme.desc: Hay veces que las familias son separadas por situaciones fortuitas. Alejandro Muñoz es un periodista cuyo propósito en su programa de televisión es reunir a familias separadas por diversos motivos. Él nos cuenta algunas de sus experiencias.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Cruzando al borde
programme.desc: La patrulla fronteriza de Estados Unidos tiene registro de que la mayoría de indocumentados que cruzan la frontera son centroamericanos. Dentro de esta población hay muchos menores de edad que viajan solos para reunirse con sus familiares.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Historias de Puebla York
programme.desc: En Nueva York existe una importante cantidad de población inmigrante proveniente de Casa Blanca, un pueblo del estado de Puebla en México. Ellos desean reunirse de nuevo con sus padres después de muchos años de no verlos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Deportation INC
programme.desc: La inmigración a Estados Unidos se ha convertido en una industria con un enfoque monetario. En este episodio se dan a conocer las implicaciones monetarias además de los estragos emocionales que deja en los inmigrantes.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Ángeles y Demonios
programme.desc: Salmo 100 es una organización que lleva mensajes de paz y reconciliación. Las historias de Daniel, Adrián o Giovanni son ejemplos que usa Salmo 100 para ayudar a más personas que quieren salir del mundo del crimen organizado en la frontera.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Los Deportables
programme.desc: Las redadas que realizan los agentes de migración han hecho que el miedo tome muchos vecindarios de Estados Unidos. Las historias de quienes han sido deportados son contadas. También las historias de quienes viven temerosos de ser deportados.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Deportaciones masivas: Miedo y realidad
programme.desc: El miedo a las deportaciones masivas, dentro de las comunidades latinas, aumentó después de nuevas reglas anunciadas para la expulsión de inmigrantes indocumentados. Los inmigrantes están cansados de vivir en la ansiedad y han decidido auto deportarse.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Inmigración: Las nuevas reglas
programme.desc: Las recientes redadas de inmigración en varios estados de la nación han despertado el temor en muchas comunidades. Familias trabajadoras están pensando dos veces antes de salir a su empleo o enviar los niños a la escuela.

programme.title: Corazón salvaje
programme.desc: En una isla caribeña a principios del siglo XX, los hermanos Juan del Diablo y Renato D’Autremont se ven envueltos en los enredos de Mónica de Molnar, una joven frívola y calculadora, quien se entromete con el verdadero amor de su hermana Aimee de Molnar.

programme.title: El jinete solitario en el valle de los desaparecidos
programme.desc: Unos bandoleros que se dedican a trabajar minas de manera clandestina, raptan a Don Rosendo, quien ha encontrado una mina de un metal muy valioso. 'El jinete solitario' ayuda a Don Rosendo y a Rosita, capturando a los bandoleros.

programme.title: La mano que aprieta
programme.desc: Ángel y Satán son luchadores enmascarados que deben luchar contra un villano con el poder de ser invisible y quien posee una máquina de rayos con la que intenta imponer su ley.

programme.title: Cortesana

programme.desc: En medio de un forcejeo, Dominga cae al piso y pierde el conocimiento, Esmeralda se estremece al hallarla desfallecida. José Armando tiene un enfrentamiento con su padre, Rodolfo le da un ultimátum si no termina la relación con Esmeralda.

programme.title: Pasión Capítulo 13
programme.desc: Santiago y Camila lloran juntos su desventura, pero entienden que no pueden hacer nada. Rita se entera que Camila volvió y se pone furiosa. Mercedes muere y Ricardo piensa cumplir su promesa de exigir sus bienes. Alberto le ofrece matrimonio a Úrsula.

programme.title: Tres Veces Ana Capítulo 54
programme.desc: Marcelo amenaza a Samuel y él acepta ser su abogado. Tras discutir con Ana Leticia, Ana Laura cae por las escaleras. Ana Laura le cuenta a Ramiro que Valentín busca vengarse de él. Ramiro y Ana Laura le entregan a Ernestina la pulsera de Ana Lucía.

programme.title: Fuego en la Sangre Capítulo 98
programme.desc: Juan y sus hermanos encuentran el testamento de sus padres. Gabriela le deja en claro a Sofía que su amor por Fernando es lo más importante. Fernando le hace creer a Gabriela que sus acercamientos hacia Sofía son solo para quitarle la hacienda.

programme.title: Amores con Trampa Capítulo 44
programme.desc: Felipe le dice a Francisca que después de todo lo que hizo no quiere volver a verla y le pide a Carmen que decida entre Diego y él. Santiago le dice a María que Isabel y Facundo se fueron a comer. Enojada, María decide irse con Jacinto y Susana al pueblo.

programme.title: Qué Bonito Amor Capítulo 136
programme.desc: Santos le pide a Justo que deje de investigar a Vittoriano y se comunica con María para decirle que cumpla su promesa de vivir por los dos, despidiéndose definitivamente de ella. Lourdes trata de hacer entrar en razón a Elvira, pero ella se niega.

programme.title: Pasión y poder Capítulo 24
programme.desc: Aldo descubre algo de Consuelo que Montserrat utilizará para dominar a Erick y convertirse en una Montenegro. David le confiesa a Julia que la chica que besó en Querétaro es Regina Montenegro y que lucharán juntos por su amor.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Olga ha dedicado toda su vida al cuidado de su hija, quien nació con problemas neuronales. Por otro lado, Rosa se enamora de un chico mucho más joven que ella y decide divorciarse.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Acusan a David de violar a Aidé, pero ella asegura que él de quien abusó fue de su hermana. Le entrega los ahorros a su marido para comprar un camión, pero él lo invierte en su otra familia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Fernando no quiere más hijos, pero su esposa se aprovecha de él mientras duerme para tener sexo. Lázaro vandaliza la empresa de Orlando porque envía suministros a la dictadura de Daniel Ortega.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lo protege durante el día, pero de noche lo viola y le dice que él es gay. Rafael descubre que su esposa Doris tiene en la casa un negocio de prostitución con muñecas inflables.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Fue detenida por tráfico animal, ella culpa a Roberto por la tortuga que lleva en la vagina. Exige emanciparse de su padre por su comportamiento violento, él alega que la agresiva era la madre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su esposo muere porque la ambulancia no llegó a tiempo al hospital, ella demanda al chofer. Pablo y Ernesto tienen una relación de amor, odio, deseo y celos que no los deja vivir en armonía.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: Tim negocia con Aurelio para impedir el paso del uranio. Leonor queda fuera del caso Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas se enfrenta al Tijeras para cobrarle el asesinato de Chacorta, mientras se salva de la muerte a manos de aliados de Marcado. Julia busca a Leonor para que ayude a Tim.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim y Rivero atacan al Chema, mientras Marcado y Medardo asaltan el búnker para matar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas mata a Medardo, y Marcado huye para ayudar al Chema luego de que Tim y Rivero incautan el uranio. Tijeras también escapa, mientras Mónica acepta la condición de Omar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor golpea a Casillas, lo deja herido y amenaza con matarlo: ahora sabe que sexo y muerte van de la mano. Mónica y Rutila ya tienen su propio negocio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas busca a Mónica, pero ella lo rechaza y le dice que se aleje de su hijo, mientras el Chema amenaza a Rutila. Tijeras convence a Marcado y se escapan a Colombia en un avión del Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas sorprende a su familia, pero Irma lo acusa de haber entregado a Chacorta a cambio de su libertad. Rutila recibe la carta de Ernesto, mientras el Chema le exige que seduzca a Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim le pide a Casillas que le envíe un cargamento de droga a Chicago, pero él no tiene ni mercancía ni dinero para volver a montar su red de narcotráfico. Leonor ve de nuevo a Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas jura ante la tumba de Chacorta que vengará su muerte, y acusa a Irma de ser la culpable por convencerlo de dejar el negocio. Prepara una coartada para llevar a cabo su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio mata a Irma, y hace ver que murió en el ataque de la Policía y la Marina al rancho de Sinaloa. Logran escapar del tiroteo, pero Chabela queda malherida. Feyo promete enviar la droga.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor llora la muerte de Chabela y de sus hijos, mientras Casillas le plantea la venganza. Tim trata de convencer a Rivero de que Aurelio no estaba en Sinaloa. Leonor busca olvidar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor le dice a Aurelio que acepta entrar en el negocio para vengar la muerte de Chabela y sus hijos, y le entrega el dinero de la venta del ganado. Mónica le exige al Chema que se aleje.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas intenta seducir a la Condesa, quien le coquetea, pero asegura que es fiel a Feyo. Víctor quiere comenzar su venganza y matar al que dio el pitazo de que estaba en el rancho de Sinaloa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor viaja con Aurelio a Chicago para entregar la droga a Tim, y crecen sus sospechas sobre el Espanto. Rutila visita a Ernesto y le miente, mientras doña Alba la compara con su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema secuestra a su propio hijo para demostrarle a Rutila que él pone las reglas, mientras su rabia aumenta luego de que el Güero le dice que le hizo una visita conyugal a Ernesto.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: When their attempt to rob a gangster's (Robert De Niro) casino goes awry, a desperate man (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and his partner (Dave Bautista) hijack a city bus to escape from the police and a maniacal thug (Morris Chestnut).

programme.title: Cash Out
programme.desc: Tempted by what could be his biggest score ever, professional thief Mason joins forces with his younger brother to rob a bank. However, when the heist goes awry, the thieves find themselves trapped inside, surrounded by SWAT teams, the FBI and Interpol. Things get even more tense when Mason eventually talks to the lead negotiator -- his former lover.

programme.title: Confidence
programme.desc: In this glossy neo-noir caper, expert grifter Jake Vig (Edward Burns) inadvertently crosses volatile crime boss the King (Dustin Hoffman) and, to make it right, he must agree to con banker Morgan Price (Robert Forster). He assembles his team, including Lily (Rachel Weisz) and Gordo (Paul Giamatti), but things get complicated fast with the arrival of Special Agent Gunther Butan (Andy Garcia), who has been tracking Jake for years. As the con goes down, Jake can't say who's double-crossing whom.

programme.title: Force of Nature
programme.desc: A policeman and a former cop battle a gang of thieves as they search for $55 million inside an evacuated building during a hurricane.

programme.title: Man on a Ledge
programme.desc: When disgraced ex-cop Nick Cassidy (Sam Worthington) steps onto the ledge of the highest floor of New York's famous Roosevelt Hotel, more than just his life is at risk; he threatens to bring the city to its knees. There are some very nervous people around with some very big secrets to hide. As police negotiator Lydia Spencer (Elizabeth Banks) tries to talk Nick in from the ledge, she begins to suspect that he has an ulterior motive behind his actions.

programme.title: Den of Thieves
programme.desc: Nick O'Brien is the hard-drinking leader of the Regulators, an elite unit of the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department. Ray Merrimen is the recently paroled leader of the Outlaws, a gang of ex-military men who use their expertise and tactical skills to evade the law. O'Brien, Merrimen and their crews soon find themselves on a direct collision course as the criminals hatch an elaborate plan for a seemingly impossible heist -- the city's Federal Reserve Bank.

programme.title: The Last Man
programme.desc: A veteran who's suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder takes the advice of a street prophet and starts preparing for the end of days.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A military experiment to harness unlimited energy goes horribly awry, leaving a pilot with no choice but to fight through an imploding world to save his family and the planet itself.

programme.title: Knowing
programme.desc: Fifty years after it was buried in a time capsule, a schoolgirl's cryptic document falls into the hands of Caleb Koestler, the son of professor John Koestler (Nicolas Cage). John figures out that the encoded message accurately lists every major disaster from the past five decades, and predicts three future calamities -- one a global cataclysm. When his warnings fall on deaf ears, John enlists the help of the prophetic author's daughter and granddaughter to try to avert the ultimate disaster.

programme.title: Kin
programme.desc: While scavenging for copper wire, Detroit teenager Eli Solinski stumbles upon a high-tech gun that holds special powers. When his brother, Jimmy, lands in trouble with a local crime boss, the two siblings take the mysterious weapon and go on the run. Eli and Jimmy now find themselves in a life-and-death battle against an army of thugs and two heavily armored, futuristic soldiers who want their gun back.

programme.title: The Last Man
programme.desc: A veteran who's suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder takes the advice of a street prophet and starts preparing for the end of days.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A military experiment to harness unlimited energy goes horribly awry, leaving a pilot with no choice but to fight through an imploding world to save his family and the planet itself.

programme.title: Promise Chronicles: Manifestation
programme.desc: A despairing group of Christians and non-believer's band together during the biblical period, known as Tribulation, not only to survive death, but to escape America, and uncover a sinister globalist plot designed by an overreaching government.

programme.title: The Locator
programme.desc: Government-trained assassin Braxton is The Locator! Hand-picked for a special taskforce, his objective is to remove any threats to the safety and stability of the United States. With blood on his hands after completing the order to eliminate his partner, Braxton loses his lust for killing. When the governments best hit man walks off the job, the order is given to bring Braxton back or take him down.

programme.title: Sweet Justice
programme.desc: Four women run a private child support clinic by day but are collectors at night. Seeking out deadbeat parents and using seduction and force to make them pay up.

programme.title: Krooked Lines
programme.desc: It's a race against time in this fast moving suspense drama where the lines between cops, criminals, love, and loyalty intersect. Two friends, one motivated by the law, the other motivated by money, try to bring down a human trafficking ring, while dealing with the death of a lover, and revelation of an undercover affair. The bond must survive, even when there is no one to trust.

programme.title: CUT
programme.desc: Bunny is attempting to rebuild her life in Atlanta. Her financial aid suddenly falls through, until she meets Renee who shows her the ways of hustling and fast money, as well as Ed, a music producer and drug addict. Will her bad choices and mistake take her down the wrong path?

programme.title: A Wolf's Cries
programme.desc: Janice is a compulsive liar. In her new friend group, she causes chaos, breaking up couples and getting friends arrested. Believing she deserves everything; it's her way or the highway. Until someone sees her manipulation and aims to expose her.

programme.title: A Chosen Hope
programme.desc: After escaping her abusive husband, Talia has forged a new life for her and her daughter, Hope. When Hope begins experiencing mental illness and troubling visions, Talia learns her husband was part of a sinister cult, and Hope is marked as "The Chosen Soul". Talia must race against time to save her daughter before it's too late.

programme.title: Hearts in Colombo
programme.desc: When Rick surprises Shanaya by flying to Sri Lanka for Christmas, meeting her eccentric family leads to chaos, wild antics, and culture clash. Can their relationship survive the ultimate holiday test in this heartwarming Sri Lankan rom-com?

programme.title: When You Finish Saving the World
programme.desc: Evelyn (Julianne Moore) tries to parent an unassuming teenager at her shelter while her oblivious son Ziggy (Finn Wolfhard) fumbles through his pursuit of a brilliant young woman at school.

programme.title: You Hurt My Feelings
programme.desc: A novelist's (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) longstanding marriage is suddenly upended when she overhears her husband give his honest reaction to her latest book. A film about trust, lies, and the things we say to the people we love most.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: Middle-aged filmmaker Josh Srebnick (Ben Stiller) and his wife, Cornelia (Naomi Watts), are happily married, but stuck in a rut. So, when free-spirited couple Jamie (Adam Driver) and Darby (Amanda Seyfried) enter their lives, it's like a breath of fresh air -- especially for Josh, who pines for a youth he wishes he had. Soon, Josh and Cornelia are ditching friends their own age to hang out with the hipsters -- but whether the friendship can endure despite a 20-year age gap remains to be seen.

programme.title: You Hurt My Feelings
programme.desc: A novelist's (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) longstanding marriage is suddenly upended when she overhears her husband give his honest reaction to her latest book. A film about trust, lies, and the things we say to the people we love most.

programme.title: Goon
programme.desc: Not content with his job as a bouncer, Doug Glatt (Seann William Scott) dreams of a more rewarding job and gaining his parents' respect.

programme.title: Dream Scenario
programme.desc: Hapless family man Paul Matthews (Nicolas Cage) finds his life turned upside down when millions of strangers suddenly start seeing him in their dreams. But when his nighttime appearances take a nightmarish turn, Paul is forced to navigate the consequences of his newfound stardom.

programme.title: The Voices
programme.desc: A dark comedy about a likeable guy (Ryan Reynolds) pursuing his office crush with the help of his evil talking pets - but things turn sinister when she stands him up for a date.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: After his father, an assassin, is brutally murdered, Nick Gant vows revenge on Division, the covert government agency that dabbles in psychic warfare and experimental drugs. Hiding in Hong Kong's underworld, Nick assembles a band of rogue psychics dedicated to destroying Division. Together with Cassie, a teenage clairvoyant, Nick goes in search of a missing girl and a stolen suitcase that could be the key to accomplishing their mutual goal.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a comet causes a radiation storm on Earth, machines come to life and turn against their makers. Holed up in a North Carolina truck stop, a group of survivors must fend for themselves against a mass of homicidal trucks. A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.
A naïve young man assumes a dead man's identity in order to join an underworld game of Russian roulette. Costarring Mickey Rourke, Jason Statham, and Michael Shannon.

programme.title: Salvation
programme.desc: A foster child bonds with a snake-handling Pentecostal community but uncovers sinister truths. She must choose between reporting pastor's crimes or preserving her newfound support system, risking personal safety for a sense of belonging.

programme.title: P2
programme.desc: Angela (Rachel Nichols) is working late on Christmas Eve. When she finally decides to leave, she goes down to the parking garage to get her car, but it won't start. Thomas (Wes Bentley), the garage's security guard, offers to help. He also invites Angela to dinner, but she refuses. Thomas, crazed, knocks her out. She wakes up in Thomas' office, chained to a chair and in different clothes. Now Angela must fight for her life in order the escape from the garage.

programme.title: A Heart For Christmas
programme.desc: A young girl's Christmas wish comes true when the mom she never knew comes home for the holidays, but the family reunion gets complicated now that her father's heart belongs to someone else.

programme.title: A Family Matters Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas is anything but ordinary when three siblings from a newly blended household cannot see eye to eye. With the help of some magic, they switch bodies and cannot change back until they learn to spend the holidays as a loving family.

programme.title: Snowbound for Christmas
programme.desc: A marketing executive is invited by her charming and handsome boss to pitch a major project to prospective clients at a posh resort and the two get snowed in together before any of the other guests can arrive. Now, with the hotel to themselves, a fairytale snowscape outside and sparks flying inside they find that being alone together is all the Christmas magic they need.

programme.title: A Husband for Christmas
programme.desc: Brooke and Roger, two graphic designers in a soon-to-be-merged company, help one another by agreeing to a loveless marriage of convenience. In the process, Brooke gets to upstage her sister who just announced her engagement to Brooke's ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: More Than a Game
programme.desc: Filmmaker Kristopher Belman chronicles the early career of basketball superstar LeBron James. James and four other talented teammates were a powerhouse combination at St. Vincent-St. Mary High School in Akron, Ohio. The five-star athletes burned up the courts throughout Ohio, but James' ever-increasing celebrity threatened to tear apart all the five had worked so hard to achieve.

programme.title: The Fisherman
programme.desc: Shortly after Steven immigrates to the United States from Nigeria for greener pastures, his health challenges get in the way of his ambition. A terrifying cardiac episode at the park brings Elijah his way, a grieving father battling the loss of his son. As Steven's heart condition worsens, posing the threat of failure, Elijah offers to pay for a heart surgery to get him a new heart, afraid of losing another son.

programme.title: Pinkerton
programme.desc: Allan Pinkerton, founder of America's first detective agency, embarks on a mission to capture the notorious outlaw, Jesse James.

programme.title: Joe Baby
programme.desc: A money collector for a private investigator is hired to track down 10 million dollars stolen in a dodgy real estate deal, opening a complex can of worms.

programme.title: Jesse James
programme.desc: Jesse James and his brother Frank race to secure the family's buried gold as members of the James-Younger gang attempt to steal it.

programme.desc: A bachelor party in the middle of nowhere quickly turns into a night of murder and mystery when the best man ends up with a knife in his head. Everyone is a suspect; only an eccentric private eye in town can solve the mystery.

programme.desc: In a society ruled by genetically enhanced elites, outcasts Leon (Tom Felton) and Chloe fight to expose corruption and challenge a system built on genetic disparity. Directed by Timo Vuorensola (Iron Sky), Altered is a gripping sci-fi thriller of resistance, justice, and survival.

programme.title: My Mom Vs. My Man!

Can they end their power struggle in time to save their marriage?

programme.title: Vegetarian Diet Increase Strokes?

programme.title: Live In The OR

programme.title: Competitive Parents

programme.title: More Controlling People w/ Rochelle

Can Dr. Phil help her reach a happy medium?

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

Steve and Tango start off their night on the second floor. While the guys are walking around a door suddenly opens and then slams shut all on its own, leaving the guys speechless.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Derby, Connecticut to investigate one of the country's oldest Opera houses, the Sterling Opera House. programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

Some of the paranormal claims by staff members includes unexplained reflections, voices, full body apparitions, shadow figures, the sounds of machines, and people seeing a little boy known as Jeffrey. After seeing Jeffrey, the patients would soon pass away.

programme.desc: For nearly 50 years, enthusiasts from all over the world have flocked to the Barrett-Jackson collector car auctions, named America's No. 1 Attraction for Car Lovers in the 2019 USA Today Readers? programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: At the base of Italian cuisine are essential Italian ingredients and vinegar is one of them. Lidia masters the art of cooking with vinegar in this episode. She prepares a Red Cabbage and Bacon Salad in a warm bacon and balsamic vinegar dressing; Chicken in Vinegar Sauce; and a tangy garlic Savoy Cabbage and Potatoes dish.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia attended school near the beautiful city of Trieste before coming to America and picked up many essential skills from the nuns who ran it. Inspired by the soups she had for school lunches, she prepares a Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup, as well as a one pot meal of Sausages and Apples that can feed a hungry family.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Every cook dreams of a perfectly roasted chicken, and today Lidia shows the viewer how to do just that. She starts with an American favorite - a crunchy, cheese Caesar Salad. Her Lemon Roasted Chicken goes beyond comfort food with onions, rosemary and lots of lemons. Finally she prepares a free form Crostata with Juicy Plums.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Mussel bruschetta; a tasting of olive oil; spaghetti in lemon cream sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

Fried food always hits the spot and next on the menu is Fried Onion Rings, made Italian-style with Grana Padano cheese added to the batter for flavor and crunch; and finally, Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms is a rich dish that is perfect for colder months.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Eggs were always a favorite at Lidia's home as a kid and they still are. programme.title: Reunion
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.desc: The story of Jova leads us deep inside the fundamentally changing society of the Vikings.

programme.desc: An enormous explosion brings down the hotel. Ninety-one people die.

programme.title: The Bar - Algiers, 1956
programme.desc: Three people are killed and many more are injured.

programme.title: The Games - Munich, 1972
programme.desc: Eight Palestinians attack the apartments of the Israeli delegation and kill two athletes.

programme.title: WWII In Color: US Army Air Forces
programme.desc: The continued dedication and bravery of the men and women of the air force brings about the collapse of the Third Reich and Germany's surrender. A new generation of super bombers is born out of America's latest technological leap, and, together with the ever more effective combat strategies, US Air Force missions help to bring down the curtain in the empire of the rising sun.

programme.title: Iron Curtain - Life Under Soviet Occupation
programme.desc: 1944-45. As the Red Army pushes toward Berlin, Stalin seizes Eastern Europe, exploiting postwar chaos to impose communist regimes. Industries are requisitioned, propaganda expands, and dissent crushed through arrests. Marxism-Leninism becomes the only creed. By the late 1940s, the Iron Curtain has fallen, sealing millions under Soviet rule.

programme.title: The Life of Adolf Hitler: Rise of a Demon
programme.desc: The story of Adolf Hitler during the pre-war years when the Nazi party exercised complete power over Germany is told using contemporary news reels.

programme.title: The Fall of Berlin
programme.desc: After many years of bitter fighting and destruction; Nazi Germany͛s once powerful ͚war machine' began to falter. As the allies at last made positive advances, Hitler͛s shattered armies started their weary retreat back towards the fatherland. Weakened by a relentless allied push on all fronts Hitler confines himself to Nazi capital city, Berlin.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: The commanders of the First and Third American Army, General Omar Bradley and General George S. Patton Jr. are discussed.

programme.title: Living in the Shadow of WWII
programme.desc: Total war extends the battlefields - in the Second World War, for the first time, civilian casualties far outnumbered those of military personnel. And a significant proportion of those casualties were victims of the bombing campaigns waged by both sides. What was the effect of living through 'the Blitz', what precautions were taken, what forms of shelter were constructed?

programme.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
programme.desc: In the early morning hours of the 17th of January 1991, coalition air forces unleashed a massive air assault on Iraqi forces in both Iraq and Kuwait. The magnitude of the coalition air offensive dealt a crushing blow to Iraq's air defense network.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Secrets: Hitler, Himmler, and the Occult
programme.desc: The link between Hitler, the esoteric mystical movement of the nineteenth century and the Aryan mythology of the Waffen SS is finally established. See how the surviving snippets of film and documentary evidence prove that Hitler and the Nazi movement were duped by a series of charlatans into creating a framework for a pseudo-religious new world order which was based solely on a series of frauds.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: Unknown Images
programme.desc: As peace negotiations dragged on, U.S. soldiers faced new threats and dangers - and a largely conscript army started to come apart under pressure. Once-censored film footage provides a shocking insight, from the carnage of Hamburger Hill to vicious fighting in the Mekong Delta.

programme.title: Great Battles Of The Civil War: Volume 2
programme.desc: This in depth volume combines archival material with faithfully created battle re-enactments to depict the real horror and heroism of the American Civil War combat from 1863-1865. Witness the sacrifice of over 600,000 patriots in fierce hand-to-hand combat and face-to-face warfare struggling to preserve their ways of life.

programme.title: Kwai - The Death Railway
programme.desc: In 1942, Japan forced over 200,000 Asian civilians and 65,000 Western POWs to build a railway through the Thai-Burmese jungle. After 15 months, 120,000 were dead from exhaustion, hunger, and disease. Today, the bridge on the river draws tourists, while survivors recall the harrowing sacrifices and human cost behind its construction.

programme.title: Works of Art Stolen by The Nazis
programme.desc: The film examines the mechanisms of Nazi extortion during the Second World War, and is interspersed with current issues surrounding restitutions. It retraces the incredible stories of 3 major works having belonged to Jewish collectors, from their plundering by the Nazis though to their final restitution.

programme.title: Great Native American Warrior Chiefs
programme.desc: From age to age, across the lands, Native Americans have made their mark in history. Take a closer look at Native American stories that will be told for generations. Learn about Chief Big Foot, Sitting Bull, Cochise, Black Hawk, Chief Joseph and more.

programme.title: Marie Antoinette: The Trial of a Queen
programme.desc: On the night of August 2, 1793, Marie Antoinette is transferred to the Conciergerie. Her husband has been sent to the guillotine, her children have been taken away, all the other European monarchies have abandoned her and France is calling for her head. She was judged as a queen, her tragic death made her immortal. Thanks to secret documents freshly decoded this film grasps her last days.

programme.title: The Ace's War
programme.desc: At the dawn of the 20th Century, the future of aviation is in the hands of a few visionaries and daredevils. In 1903 American brothers Wilbur and Orville Wright make four flights of a few dozen meters on a North Carolina beach. The age of the pioneers ends suddenly in 1914 with the outbreak of the First World War.

programme.title: Princess Alice: The Queen's Mother-In-Law
programme.desc: Featuring exclusive interviews and archived footage, this film sheds new light on one of the royal family's most unknown personalities. Princess Alice, a great granddaughter of Queen Victoria, married into the Greek royal family before their monarchy was overthrown by revolution. She was later placed in mental hospitals and subjected to experiments by psychiatrists such as Sigmund Freud himself.

programme.title: Queen Victoria's Letters: A Monarch Unveiled
programme.desc: As AN Wilson explores Queen Victoria's complex relationship with her mother, he discovers the Queen Mother may not have been as cold towards her daughter as commonly perceived.

programme.title: Life in the Time of
programme.desc: Take a dive into ancient Rome, where gladiatorial fights took place regularly. As of the 3rd century BC, these were highlights in the life of the city. In the amphitheatres, the crowd thronged to see professional fighters, free or slaves, sometimes to the death. Schools dedicated to learning the art of combat were throughout the Empire, those of Aquileia and Capua being among the most famous.

programme.title: The Rise and Fall of Versailles
programme.desc: As a military leader, Louis XV, was popular and successful, but he led France into the disastrous Seven Year War with Britain. As his Empire dwindled, Louis amused himself with scandalous love affairs, his own private brothel and bedded five sisters from the same aristocratic family. This is a florid and hugely enjoyable saga of sex, war, torture, gluttony, and some truly astonishing wigs.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Perseus was not meant to come into the world. Fearing the fulfilment of the prediction according to which his grandson would kill him, King Acrisius shut his daughter Danaë away in a fortified tower.

programme.title: Inside The Tower of London: Crimes, Conspiracies, Confessions
programme.desc: The Princess in the Tower, who lost their lives in mysterious circumstances; evil Judge Jeffries and how he came to regret his actions, and the larger than life Colonel Blood, who remains the only person to steal the Crown Jewels, and how he got away with it; also the story of the last man to be executed there.

programme.title: Great Greek Myths
programme.desc: Theseus was the fruit of dual paternity: Aegeus King of Athens slept with Aethra when she had just been raped by Poseidon, God of the Sea. Theseus, who grew into a strong, brave young man, therefore had a double lineage - both divine and royal. But Theseus' great courage did not stop him from neglecting his duties. Carried along by his victory, he committed a few irreversible oversights.

programme.title: Thunder Run on Baghdad
programme.desc: The Iraqis wait, divided between hope and fear. Members of the military attempt to save face, knowing that their equipment, which dates at best from the early 1970s, will not weigh heavily against the five hundred armored tanks and seventy thousand men who are equipped with the very latest technology.

programme.title: Mystical Hidden Scenery: Jusanji Pond, Cheongsong EP.4 <12>

programme.title: Carving Gentle Light: Jade Crafting <24>

programme.title: Continuing Tradition and Taste: Making Jang <14>

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Los mirreyes
programme.desc: Los mirreyes son la nueva generación de los hijos de papi. Privilegiados y desafiantes, tratan con desprecio a quienes les sirven. Los secretos de los hijos de los ricos y los poderosos son la evidencia de la guerra de clases en el México de hoy.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Tortura en México
programme.desc: Fueron interrogados, y pronto, las preguntas se convirtieron en golpes. El drama de quienes han sufrido la tortura en carne propia, y también, un ex militar justifica sus acciones.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Frutos del odio
programme.desc: Intimidación e insultos racistas, amenazas y ataques físicos. Letreros racistas pintados en las paredes, pareciera no haber lugar seguro. Una nueva realidad se está viviendo en muchos vecindarios.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Doble vida
programme.desc: De día es un estudiante universitario, de noche bailarín exótico. Para unos era su guía espiritual, para otros era un peligro para su comunidad.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - En la boca del lobo
programme.desc: En medio de las tensiones raciales de los últimos meses, Ilia Calderón se adentra en el mundo del grupo supremacista blanco Ku Klux Klan y entrevista a uno de sus líderes. El encuentro está lleno de amenazas e insultos.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Juan Gabriel íntimo
programme.desc: Hablan quienes lo conocieron desde niño y quienes fueron testigos de su genio musical. Los rituales antes de enfrentar a su público y el testimonio de quienes permanecieron cerca de él, a un año de su muerte.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - La amenaza de la amapola
programme.desc: En los campos de la Sierra de Guerrero, México, florecen la amapola y la violencia. Familias campesinas se ganan la vida con los cultivos ilegales, mientras que los carteles de la droga buscan controlar el mercado.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Traicionados por la justicia
programme.desc: Alrededor de cincuenta jóvenes de un mismo vecindario recibieron acusaciones de homicidios que los marcaron para siempre. Algunos pasaron décadas en prisión, otros están aún intentando limpiar sus nombres.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - Alas del narco
programme.desc: El drama de las misteriosas desapariciones de pilotos y los riesgos a los que se exponen en las selvas andinas.

programme.title: Aquí y Ahora - ¿Comida cruel?
programme.desc: Una pareja acepta el reto de cambiar sus hábitos alimenticios, dejar de comer carne y llevar una dieta balanceada. Y la historia de Yumalay Díaz, un niño de 4 años que, con su participación en un reality, quiere cambiar su vida y la de sus papás.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 189
programme.desc: Mía y Roberta se enteran de que sus papás se encargarán de organizar su fiesta. Vico le dice a Nico que la culpa de que Lupita decidiera dejar la escuela es de Celina.

programme.desc: Diego no quiere que su papá vea la propaganda de RBD. José recibe un regalo de su tutor. Roberta entierra el vestido que usará Mía en su fiesta. Mía le dice a Alma que fingió criticar la ropa de Vico y Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 192
programme.desc: Roberta está muy preocupada porque destruyó el vestido de Mía por las razones equivocadas. Mía ocasiona que Roberta caiga y se desmaye. Diego le regala un anillo a Roberta y Miguel le regala a Mía una rosa, por su cumpleaños.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 193
programme.desc: Roberta se disculpa con Mía por haber arruinado su vestido. Alma le regala a Roberta una motocicleta. Para arruinarle el día a Mía, alguien le envía de regalo una carta de felicitación de su mamá. Alma lleva a Marcelino para que felicite a Roberta.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 194
programme.desc: Roberta y Mía festejan su cumpleaños con una gran fiesta. Pilar le explica a Enrique que planeaba arruinar la fiesta de Mía y Roberta porque no la invitaron. Franco descubre que Alma encerró a Valeria. Peter abandona a Valeria en una calle.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 195
programme.desc: Roberta acepta ser novia de Simón. Mía le agradece a Roberta que le haya regalado su vestido. Roberta le dice a Mía que se le nota que adora a Miguel. RBD canta en la fiesta.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 196
programme.desc: Mía finge estar ebria y besa a Miguel. Peter renuncia antes de que lo corra Franco, por Valeria. Diego le confiesa a Tomás estar enamorado de Roberta. Gastón enfurece porque Mía termina con él. Alma le dice a Valeria que fue muy cruel con Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 197
programme.desc: Gastón amenaza a Miguel con revelar su venganza en contra de Franco y Mía. Simón y Diego tienen un enfrentamiento por Roberta. Miguel le exige a Mía que le diga a Gastón que no son novios. Peter le dice a Mía que fue él quien le envió la carta.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 198
programme.desc: Peter le dice a Mía que la carta que recibió fue escrita por su mamá hace varios años. Franco se enoja porque Mía decide irse a vivir con Alma. Roberta piensa vivir con Franco si Mía vive en su casa. Alma y Franco discuten por Peter.

programme.title: Rebelde Capítulo 199
programme.desc: Roberta acusa a Pilar de mentirosa. Roberta y Alma discuten por Mía. León necesita el lugar donde tocara RBD para su campaña. Gastón le dice a Mía que Miguel quiere vengarse de Franco porque cree que es responsable de la muerte de su padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Antonio un cazatalentos de jugadores de béisbol, termina involucrado en un problema de drogas. Luis le dijo un piropo fuera de tono a Isabel, y ella reacciona mal al sentirse acosada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El interés en una herencia ha motivado a Sandra a hacer lo imposible para que Wilmer no sea el beneficiado y de esta forma mantener a su hija como heredera. Melissa quiere recuperar a su hijo, que fue adoptado por Raúl, quien, junto a su esposa, ha cuidado al niño como parte de un negocio con el padre del chico, que es un capo que está en la cárcel y pronto saldrá a buscar al niño.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: A Mateo, creador de un personaje anónimo de magazine, lo presionan para que dé la cara. Heidy decidió viajar por el mundo, pero sus vacaciones las pagan los hombres que encuentra en el camino.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: René pide el divorcio de Andrea porque ella mintió al decir que tenía cáncer para esconder un chupón de su amante. Cristal tiene una cerdita de mascota, su esposo dice que los puercos se comen.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: José Ángel le dispara al perro de su vecina, ella pide compensación, él alega que fue en defensa propia. Venda un ovario y años después se entera de que en la cirugía le extirparon el útero.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Al salir en libertad, Diana le pide a Ceci que le dé la propiedad que tienen en común porque cumplió prisión por su culpa. Fidel le promete a Lorena que en tres meses triplicaría la inversión.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sofía le exige a su esposo Carlos, un venezolano que quiere regresar a su patria, que pida asilo político en los Estados Unidos, de lo contrario pide el divorcio y la custodia total de su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alejandra demanda a su jefe por suprimir la cobertura de anticonceptivos de su seguro médico. El padre de Susana desaparece, ella exige su emancipación y una orden de desalojo para su madre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Orlando demanda a su esposa, pide el divorcio y 50 mil dólares, ella lo medicó para someterlo. Arturo es mexicano y Suzzy es brasileña, todo iba bien, pero el fútbol los convirtió en rivales.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: América le practica sexo oral a Alejandro en la carretera y provoca un accidente, ella está enferma. Mariana quiere que la madre biológica de su hijastra se lleve a la niña, se siente incómoda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carmen es violada y queda embarazada, además tiene cáncer, su esposo quiere que aborte. Santiago acusa a su esposa de contagiarlo con herpes, pero ella nunca lo engañó y pide una explicación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El perro de Ilarisa muerde a Sandy en la cara. Pensó que la dueña del animal era inocente; estaba equivocada. Abandonó a su esposo y a su hijo para vivir como lesbiana, pero quiere la herencia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mariana es lesbiana, su mujer le transfiere la semilla de su amante y la embaraza, quiere manutención. Ivette exige que su hija regrese a casa, le permitió emanciparse, pero ella no le cumplió.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jorge pide la custodia de su hijo, la madre le da de fumar marihuana porque el niño está enfermo. Raúl demanda a su esposa Mariana, ella no quiere dejar el paracaidismo, aunque está embarazada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Elsa exige que su esposo e hijo regresen a México; el chico cruzó solo la frontera en busca de su padre. María abandona a su familia sin explicación; tras ocho años regresa para pedir perdón.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema sigue castigando a Rutila: le dice que tiene que ganarse a su hijo o la madre sustituta lo hará. Garnica recibe el dinero para matar a Ernesto, ahora con el apoyo de Venegas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le propone a Feyo una alianza: comprar su finca, pero que, a cambio, lo ayude a matar al Chema. Leonor acusa a Rawlins de utilizar a Aurelio para inundar a Chicago de drogas y llevarse los elogios.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aunque Tim le cambió la pauta, Casillas ordena lanzar granadas a la casa del Chema, pero se entera de que ahí está el hijo de Rutila. Omar está con Mónica y recibe la visita inesperada de Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila se muda con el Chema para estar con su hijo, luego que Aurelio le echa en cara que quedó embarazada para vengarse. Tim le propone a Rivero dar un golpe con la captura de Víctor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica cae de nuevo en los brazos de Aurelio, quien le confiesa que planeó el ataque al rancho para salir de Irma, pero también murió Chabela. Marcado y Garnica le tienden una trampa al Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema escapa del ataque de Marcado. Rutila no se salva y paga las consecuencias. A Marcado no le importa nada, y mata a su propia familia frente a los ojos de la hija de Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Destrozada, Rutila le cuenta al Chema que Marcado la violó y le echa la culpa. Llama a Aurelio para que la ayude a vengarse, pero Venegas le dice que si habla, no volverá a ver a su hijo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se encuentra cara a cara con el Chema y le exige que le devuelva a su nieto, mientras Rutila se desahoga con Víctor y le advierte que ahora los dos enfrentan el odio muy de cerca.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim amenaza a Aurelio con detener a su familia, pero los planes de Morejón lo llevan a pactar con él la muerte de su jefe, Jack Meléndez. Rivero desconfía de Rawlings y aún no sabe la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila, angustiada, se refugia en Aurelio y le cuenta que Marcado la violó; él jura vengarse y rescatar a su hijo. Casillas sorprende a Víctor al pedirle ver a Cristina porque se va a entregar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le revela sus secretos a Cristina en una entrevista exclusiva, aunque puede publicarla cuando él diga. Rivero se prepara para capturar a Casillas, pero antes se reúne con Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se enfrenta a balazos con Rivero y las tropas de la Marina, y aprovecha el tiroteo para matar a Espanto. Feyo convence al Chema, y con sus hombres llegan para apoyar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En medio del tiroteo, el Chema le salva la vida a Aurelio, pero le recuerda que tiene en sus manos a su hija y a su nieto. Rivero está al borde de la muerte, mientras don Feyo resulta herido.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema secuestra a su propio hijo para demostrarle a Rutila que él pone las reglas, mientras su rabia aumenta luego de que el Güero le dice que le hizo una visita conyugal a Ernesto.

programme.title: Al rojo vivo
programme.desc: La revista noticiosa que define la agenda de la televisión en español en EE. UU. Se caracteriza por ofrecer, antes que nadie, historias que cautivan al público hispano y por presentarlas en un formato innovador que resalta el aspecto humano.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: When their attempt to rob a gangster's (Robert De Niro) casino goes awry, a desperate man (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and his partner (Dave Bautista) hijack a city bus to escape from the police and a maniacal thug (Morris Chestnut).

programme.title: Cash Out
programme.desc: Tempted by what could be his biggest score ever, professional thief Mason joins forces with his younger brother to rob a bank. However, when the heist goes awry, the thieves find themselves trapped inside, surrounded by SWAT teams, the FBI and Interpol. Things get even more tense when Mason eventually talks to the lead negotiator -- his former lover.

programme.title: Confidence
programme.desc: In this glossy neo-noir caper, expert grifter Jake Vig (Edward Burns) inadvertently crosses volatile crime boss the King (Dustin Hoffman) and, to make it right, he must agree to con banker Morgan Price (Robert Forster). He assembles his team, including Lily (Rachel Weisz) and Gordo (Paul Giamatti), but things get complicated fast with the arrival of Special Agent Gunther Butan (Andy Garcia), who has been tracking Jake for years. As the con goes down, Jake can't say who's double-crossing whom.

programme.title: Force of Nature
programme.desc: A policeman and a former cop battle a gang of thieves as they search for $55 million inside an evacuated building during a hurricane.

programme.title: Man on a Ledge
programme.desc: When disgraced ex-cop Nick Cassidy (Sam Worthington) steps onto the ledge of the highest floor of New York's famous Roosevelt Hotel, more than just his life is at risk; he threatens to bring the city to its knees. There are some very nervous people around with some very big secrets to hide. As police negotiator Lydia Spencer (Elizabeth Banks) tries to talk Nick in from the ledge, she begins to suspect that he has an ulterior motive behind his actions.

programme.title: Den of Thieves
programme.desc: Nick O'Brien is the hard-drinking leader of the Regulators, an elite unit of the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department. Ray Merrimen is the recently paroled leader of the Outlaws, a gang of ex-military men who use their expertise and tactical skills to evade the law. O'Brien, Merrimen and their crews soon find themselves on a direct collision course as the criminals hatch an elaborate plan for a seemingly impossible heist -- the city's Federal Reserve Bank.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross and his loyal men take on what they think is a routine assignment: a covert operation to invade the South American country of Vilena and overthrow its dictator. But, when they learn that the job will be a suicide mission, they must choose redemption or the destruction of their brotherhood.

programme.title: Knowing

programme.desc: The top lawyer at the Department of Homeland Security, James Percival; Gov. Jared Polis (D-Colo.); Tina Peters, former county clerk of Mesa County, Colorado; Australia's efforts to keep children under the age of 16 from having social media accounts.

programme.title: Russia's Assault on Ukrainian Civilians Raises War Crimes Concerns
programme.desc: One attack this past spring illustrates what investigators describe as Russia's strategy: On Palm Sunday, Russian missile strikes killed 35 civilians.

programme.title: Science of Life

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the Carnegie Library Homestead, in Homestead, Pennsylvania. This Library was the site of violent riots between Carnegie and the steel workers. It is said that Carnegie built the library to win the steel workers over. It is thought that steel workers or Carnegie himself could be haunting the building. Some of the reported activity includes shadow figures, books falling off shelves, apparitions, and voices.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hawaii's Plantation Village, which was once a sugar plantation. It it is now an outdoor museum with reports of spirits still wandering the property and the many authentically replicated homes. It is believed that some of the entities seen are those who committed suicide or were murdered.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS and Jason's daughter, Haily, head to Napanoch, New York to investigate the Shanley Hotel. Since its opening in 1845, The Shanley Hotel has been plagued by an abundance of inexplicable deaths and tragic events targeting children. One of these tragic stories involved a little girl named Rosie, who died as she fell down a well while playing with friends. Some of the reports are of apparitions and toys moving in various rooms of the hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to ever investigate the historic Friars Club in New York City. Built in 1904 and famous for its roasts, TAPS has been brought in to find out if comedian, Al Kelly, is behind all the activity. There have been reports that an old man can be heard grunting, cold air surrounding someone, lockers moving, shadows, and apparitions of a man sitting at a table.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Niagara Falls, NY to investigate paranormal activity that has been reported at Rapids Theater. Claims revolve around an actress who is said to have hanged herself backstage. People have heard the sound of high heels, whistling, doors opening and closing on their own and apparitions have being seen around the stage and bar areas.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Snug Harbor, in Staten Island, New York. The team is very excited to be joined by Meredith Vieira, who will help them investigate this large property that includes historic landmark buildings. The investigation focuses on a lady in white who has been seen floating throughout Snugs Harbor. She is believed to be a laundry worker, known as a Matron, who was murdered by her thirteen year old son, who she kept chained inthe basement.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out to Jefferson City, Missouri to investigate Missouri State penitentiary. Having opened in 1836,it stood as oneof the oldest and most violent prisons in America, and was referred to as "the bloodiest 47 acres". While still operational, both guards and inmates reported strange experiences at the penitentiary. It continued even after its doorsclosed. Some of the activity reportedincludes apparitions of men and women, doors slamming, and footsteps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads back to the fan favorite, Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Kentucky, where more activity has been reported and a nurse's wing has been opened up for TAPS to explore. The activity reported includes solid dark shadows and voices. Stave and Tango start out their night in the Death Tunnel where they hear sounds, and loud slams, but can't figure out what caused it.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to one of the oldest distilleries in America, Buffalo Trace, in Frankfort, Kentucky. Operating since the 18th century, its former president, Colonel Blanton, is believed to still be roaming the buildings. He worked and lived at the distillery for over 55 years, before passing away at his home, which was on the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called out to Hartford, CT to Elks Lodge, the oldest and largest secret fraternal organizations in the country. Elks Lodge #19 is shrouded in mystery and tragedy with a gruesome death hanging over its head....and decades of paranormal activity. Next they head to Morse Mill Hotel, in Morse Mill, Missouri - a hotel with a violent past. They are called in to help a client who is dealing with threatening spirits that emerged as renovations began.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Ohio to investigate Kings Island, an amusement park that sits on land that was the site of an awful accident. The workers here believe the people who died in the accident could be the ones still visiting the park. Some of the reported activity includes the sound of laughter, footsteps, objects being thrown, and a girl in a little blue dress who is said to be the ghost of a child buried in the nearby cemetery.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Naples, New York, to investigate the Naples Hotel. This hotel was built in 1895. There was a suicide at the hotel in the 1920's, which is when the activity is said to begin. The owners believe the ghost of the victim is still there and have nicknamed him "Topper." Some of the reported activity includes apparitions, voices, and objects being thrown.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hales Bar Dam and Marina in Tennessee, to investigate a dam that was built on Native American land. It is believed that a Cherokee chief cursed this property after he was forced off it. Due to numerous problems, Hales Bar Dam took eight years to complete and was finally finished in 1907. During the building of this dam there were many tragedies such as accidental deaths, including workers being buried alive in cement walls.

programme.desc: For nearly 50 years, enthusiasts from all over the world have flocked to the Barrett-Jackson collector car auctions, named America's No. 1 Attraction for Car Lovers in the 2019 USA Today Readers? Choice Contest. programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia remembers some of her fondest childhood recipes that were made by her Grandmother Rosa in Italy. Recipes include Mussels Triestina and Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto. A fun and fruity Fruit Smash Soda is shared with her mother, Erminia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
